One day, a boy was playing on the beach. He had dug a really deep hole. Suddenly, he saw something blue peeking out of the sand. He hopped in and started to dig around it. He was so excited when he uncovered a navy sailboat. It was so gorgeous and it was painted a deep blue.

One day, Debra the dog was feeling really hungry. She thought that it would be nice to have something to eat. She wondered around her house and sniffed the air. Suddenly, she noticed a bowl of peppers on the kitchen table. Her eyes lit up and she started drooling. Suddenly, Debra heard her owners coming back home.

Once upon a time there was a brave knight. He always kept his sword very neat and organized. The knight wanted to move to a different castle, so he packed all of his things and headed off. When he reached the new castle, he saw that it was huge and full of soldiers! He was a bit scared, but he knew he could not turn back.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a chest full of toys and she loved to play with them. One night, Lily went to bed and had a dream. In her dream, she was playing with her toys in a big park. When she woke up, Lily told her mom about her dream.

Lily liked to draw with her pen. She had a big book with many pages. She could fill the pages with colors and shapes. She drew flowers, stars, animals and people. She was happy when she drew. One day, her pen ran out of ink. She tried to draw, but nothing came out. She was sad.

Once upon a time, there was an orange radish. It was a happy radish and loved to explore the fields in which it grew. One day, it noticed a bee buzzing around its leaves. The bee asked the radish, "Will you surrender to me?" The radish thought for a moment and finally said, "No, I can't surrender.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play together. One day, they want to travel to the park. They ask their moms if they can go. "Yes, you can go, but be careful and come back soon," their moms say. Sara and Tom are happy. They take their bikes and ride to the park. They see many things on the way.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and balls. One day, they find a big red apple on the table. They are eager to eat it. "Can I have a bite?" Tom asks. "OK, but only a little one," Sam says. He gives Tom the apple. Tom takes a big bite. He likes the sweet and juicy apple.

Tom and Sam were friends. They liked to play in the park. They had many toys, but Tom had more. Tom had a big house and a big car. He was wealthy. One day, Tom said to Sam, "Look at my toys. They are better than yours. You have old and dirty toys. You are poor." Sam felt sad.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who always wanted to buy popcorn. Every time his mom took him to the store, he would say "Mom, can I buy popcorn?" His mom would kindly say, "No, not today. Maybe tomorrow." The boy was very persistent, and kept asking every day when they went to the store. One day, his mom gave in.

Once upon a time, there was a little chicken who laid a beautiful egg. The chicken loved her egg very much because it was special to her. One day, a scary fox came to the chicken's home and wanted to take the egg away. The chicken was very scared and didn't know what to do.

Olivia was a young girl. She loved to collect animals. She went for a walk and saw a silly rabbit. She wanted to catch it, but it was too fast. Olivia said, "Rabbit, please come here! I want to collect you." But the foolish rabbit ran away in a hurry. Next, she spotted a lazy squirrel.

Jack was a creative little boy. One day, he decided to pack his bag with lots of things. He packed a hat, some snacks and some toys. Outside, he saw a tall fence. He knew he wasn't allowed to go past the fence, so he explored around it. He found some rocks, sticks and some dirt. He used his creativity to make a castle.

Anna and Ben like to play with string. They have many colors of string. They make shapes and pictures with string on the floor. They have fun. One day, they find a new string. It is black and shiny. They do not know where it came from. It is unknown. They want to play with it. "Look, Ben, a new string!" Anna says.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play in the house. The house is open. It has no door or window. It is made of wood and cardboard. Lily and Ben pretend it is their home. One day, Lily and Ben want to play different games. Lily wants to play tea party. She has a pot and cups and plates. Ben wants to play cars.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jane. She was three years old, and very impatient. One day, she was exploring in the park with her mum, when she saw a rag lying on the ground. She picked it up and beamed with delight. "Mum, can I keep this rag?" she asked. Her mum smiled. "Yes, Jane," she said.

Once upon a time, there was a sweet peach. It was round and soft and smelled good. A girl named Lucy saw the peach and wanted to touch it. She threw it in the air and it flew around. She chased it, but the peach was too fast. She was getting tired, so she lay down in the grass.

Once upon a time there was a mighty bear. He roamed the forest looking for food. He saw a bright red apple hanging from a tree. He reached up to take a closer look. He snatched the apple and took a big bite. He lay down in the grass and rested. Suddenly, he heard a voice. "What are you doing?" asked a little mouse.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the snow. One day, Timmy saw a big, colorful igloo. It was so pretty! Timmy wanted to go inside, but he was too small to reach the door. Just then, a kind lady came out of the igloo. She saw Timmy and offered to help him inside. Timmy was so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the snow. One day, she went to a big white mountain with her friends. They wanted to slide down the mountain, but it was too steep and slippery. Lily tried to slide down, but she fell and hurt her leg. She started to cry and her friends didn't know what to do.

Lily liked to eat fruits and vegetables from the garden. She liked the red apples, the yellow bananas, the green beans, and the orange carrots. She liked to eat them raw or cooked, with or without salt. She liked to eat them all. One day, she saw a new fruit in the garden. It was purple and round, with a green stem.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little boy who wanted to sail on the sea. He gathered up some wood and built a raft - it was big and strong. The little boy had a plan. He wanted to sail out on the big lake near his house, but he was a little scared. Still, he wanted to go and he made a brave face.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who was worried about a mystery. She wanted to find out what the mystery was. So she started to study. She read books and asked questions. She tried hard to find out what the mystery was. But she still couldn't figure it out. One day, the girl had an idea. She decided to walk around and look for clues.

Anna and Lily were best friends. They liked to play together every day. They had many toys and dolls, but they also liked to dress up. They had a big box of clothes and hats and shoes. One day, they wanted to dress up as princesses. They opened the box and looked for the prettiest clothes. Anna found a pink skirt with flowers.

It was a bright and sunny day and Molly was feeling excited. She had wanted to go on an adventure for what seemed like forever and now she was finally getting out of the house. She packed her bag full of snacks and put on her favourite dress. She was ready to go! Molly was a bit shy and so stopped at the edge of the large field full of tall grass.

Once there was a lonely missile. He was all alone in his big home in the sky. One day, he felt so lonely, he decided to try and find a friend. He looked down from his home to lots of different places. He recommended to himself that he visit each place, but he didn't know how. Then he thought of a plan. The missile found a big special rocket.

Mia and Leo were playing in the park. They liked to slide, swing and run. They saw a new girl sitting on a bench. She looked sad and lonely. "Let's go say hello," Mia said to Leo. "Maybe she wants to play with us." They walked to the bench and smiled at the girl. "Hi, what's your name?" Mia asked.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was three years old and loved to explore the world around her. One day, Lily felt an urge. Her tummy was rumbly and it made her excited. She asked her mom, "Can I go outside and play?" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, but be alert and stay close by."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She loved playing in the park with her friends. On the way home, she stopped to smell the delicate flowers and enjoy the warm breeze. When the little girl arrived home, her mother was waiting for her. She had a surprise for her. She showed the girl a beautiful blanket and told her it was new.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a white desk in her room where she liked to draw and color. One day, her mommy came into her room and said, "Lily, let's make a special picture together!" Lily was very excited and said, "Yes, mommy! What do we need to make it?"

Once there was a very small bunny who was very worried. He was worried about the new blueberry patch he found in the woods. The bunny thought it must have been very yummy but he was too scared to try it. One sunny morning, the bunny decided today was the day. With a big smile, he hopped to the blueberry patch and carefully tried one berry. It was sweet and juicy!

Once upon a time, there was a poor little girl walking to the park with her mom. When they arrived, the little girl saw a shiny knob on the ground. She was so excited and bent down to pick it up. "Mom, look what I found!" she said. Her mom smiled and said, "Let's see what it is."

Lily liked to design things. She had many crayons and papers. She made pretty pictures of flowers, stars, and animals. She wanted to show her pictures to her mom and dad. One day, she went to the zoo with her mom and dad. She saw many animals there. She saw lions, elephants, monkeys, and gorillas. She liked the gorillas best.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends called Lizzie and Jack. They were always together and loved to play. One day, Jack saw something scary. He noticed that Lizzie was about to drink something that she said was yummy. But it was poison! Jack ran to her and shouted "Lizzie, don't drink that!".

Once upon a time there was a girl. She was troubled. She was always sad, and never happy. One day, she decided to make a cookie. She put the ingredients in a bowl, and mixed it together. Then, she put it in the oven until it was warm and gooey and smelled really good.

Lily and Ben were playing in the park. They saw a white dove on a tree. The dove had a red ribbon around its neck. "Look, a dove!" Lily said. "It is so pretty!" "Maybe it is a gift for someone," Ben said. "But the ribbon is too tight. It hurts the dove." They wanted to help the dove.

Once upon a time, there was a little birdy. The birdy liked to fly around and look at nature. One day, the birdy saw a tree with dry leaves. The birdy felt sad for the tree. Suddenly, the birdy saw a little girl walking by. The little girl saw the birdy and smiled. The birdy felt happy and nodded its head.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very hungry and her tummy was grumbling. She asked her mommy to bring her some food. Mommy brought her a yummy sandwich, and Lily ate it all up. After eating, Lily went outside to play. She saw a little bird lying on the ground.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to play with her toys and run around outside. One day, Lily's mom noticed that Lily was not feeling well. She asked Lily if she was okay, and Lily said she didn't feel good. Lily's mom started to worry about her. She asked Lily if she had a fever or if anything hurt.

Lily and Ben like to play with their kayak. They have a big lake near their house. They paddle and splash and have fun. They wear life jackets to be safe. One day, they see a big lock on the lake. It is a gate that lets boats go up and down. They are curious. They want to see what is on the other side. They paddle to the lock.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch cartoons on TV. One day, her brother came in and disturbed her while she was watching her favorite show. She got upset and told him to go away. Later that day, Lily's mom made her a mild soup for lunch.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. They see a big hill. They want to go up the hill. "Let's run to the hill!" Lily says. "It will be fun!" "OK!" Tom says. "I like to run!" They run to the hill. They are fast. They feel the wind in their hair.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They liked to slide, swing and run. They saw a big old house near the park. It looked dark and spooky. "Let's go and see the old house," Tom said. "Maybe we can find some treasure." Lily was not sure. She felt scared. "What if there is a monster in the old house?" she asked.

Molly was walking in the woods. It was tough and she was scared. All of a sudden, she heard something behind her. She turned around to see what it was. It was a big, black raven! The raven flew toward Molly and she screamed. Molly ran away as fast as she could. The raven flew after her but Molly was too fast.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small village with her family. One day, Lily went for a walk in the forest. She saw a beautiful butterfly and followed it. Suddenly, she stumbled over a big rock and fell down. "Ouch! That hurt!" cried Lily.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play together. One day, they find a big pair of scissors in the kitchen. They have an idea. "Let's play haircut!" Sara says. "I can cut your hair and you can cut mine." "OK!" Ben says. He does not know that scissors are sharp and can hurt.

Tom and Lily were watching a cartoon on TV. They liked the cartoon very much. It was about a big dog and a small cat who were friends. The dog and the cat had many funny adventures together. Suddenly, the TV went off. Tom and Lily were sad and confused. They wanted to watch more of the cartoon. They looked at the TV and saw a black screen.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She had a purse that was empty. She wanted to go shopping, so she went to the store. At the store, she saw a lot of food and smelled the yummy smells. She wanted to feed herself. The little girl opened her purse and found it was still empty. She started to cry.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy. He had the softest, most flexible paws. Every day, the puppy would go running around the park, and playing with his best friend, the cat. One day, while they were running, they saw something shiny on the ground. It was a bright, pink ball. The puppy stopped in his tracks, and he smiled.

Once upon a time there was a generous cat. The cat liked to shine in the sunshine. One day, he saw something shiny inside a house. It was a television! The cat couldn't reach it, so he decided to ask the people living there if he could watch it. He knocked on the door and asked the people if he could watch.

Once upon a time there was an ugly trophy. It hadn't been won by anyone for a long long time. Then one day a boy came along. He wanted to help the trophy feel better. He gave it a big shiny polishing with some cloth. The trophy sparkled and glowed. The boy was so proud of his work that he decided to enter the trophy into a contest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to pick flowers in the park. One day, she saw a present on the ground. It was wrapped in shiny paper and had a big bow on top. Lily picked up the present and looked at it. She didn't know who it was for.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Daisy. Daisy was very spoiled, and she loved to tell jokes. So one day, Daisy went outside to tell her jokes. Suddenly, something made her freeze. It was a large bear! His fur was all fluffy, and he was looking right at Daisy. Daisy was scared and wasn't sure what to do.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny. He liked to hop. He hopped everywhere - across the meadow, through the flowers and over the hills. He hopped so much, he decided he wanted to hop across the whole world. The bunny hopped and hopped, but it took him a long, slow time. Then one day, the bunny heard a noise.

Lily liked to play with her toys, but she was bored of the same ones every day. She wanted something new and fun. One day, she saw a shiny wire on the floor. It looked like a snake, but it did not move. She picked it up and twisted it into different shapes. She made a circle, a star, a heart, and a flower.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily was a youth who liked to play all day. She had many friends and they all liked to play easy games together. One day, Lily saw a big red ball in the park. She really wanted the ball, so she ran to get it. As Lily played with the big red ball, her friends came over.

Jane and her dog were playing in the park. Jane was feeling brave and she wanted to try something new. She ran to the pool and looked down. Suddenly, she felt scared. Then she thought: "A dive would make me feel cooler." "Are you sure?" her dog asked.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who was very serious. She always had her nose buried in her books, learning about the kingdom and its rules. Her parents, the King and Queen, were worried that she was too serious and needed some excitement in her life. One day, the King and Queen had a surprise for the Princess.

Once there was a humble farmer. He went for a walk every day to work in his fields. One day as he was walking, he stepped on a crack in the path. He twisted his ankle! He struggled to continue walking, but the pain was too much. The farmer sat down on the ground and thought of what he could do.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and run around outside. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a big box wrapped in pretty cloth. Timmy was so happy to receive the present! He tore off the cloth and opened the box. Inside was a toy train, just like the one he had always wanted. Timmy was so excited!

One day, a little girl was walking near a river. She saw a carrot that was floating in the icy water. She exclaimed â€œOh! A vegetable!â€ She quickly scooped the carrot out of the water and looked around for something to eat it with. Suddenly, there was a splash! She looked across the river and saw a small frog.

Mia was a little girl who loved to play outside with her friends. One day she was playing and they got a bit too loud, so her mom came out to tell them to quiet down. Mia didn't like to be scolded, so she ran off into the woods behind her house. As she was running, Mia noticed that the ground was really messy and slippery.

Lila and Ben were playing with their toys in the living room. Lila had a doll and Ben had a whistle. Ben liked to blow his whistle very loud and make Lila jump. Lila did not like the noise and asked Ben to stop. "Ben, please stop blowing your whistle. It hurts my ears and makes me scared," Lila said. "No, I like my whistle.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny called Bob. Bob lived in a green meadow and he was very happy. Every morning, Bob would wake up and he would hop around the meadow. One day, Bob saw something buzzing around him. It was a mosquito! Bob stayed still and the mosquito flew away. But then the mosquito quickly came back at him.

One day, there was a slow palm tree. It stood in the middle of a wide field. Every morning, a bird would come and disturb the palm tree by sitting on its branches. The palm tree was too slow to run away and had to endure the bird's presence every day. One evening, just when the sun was starting to set, another bird arrived.

Once upon a time, a gray wolf was walking through the forest alone. He came across a bunny who was crying. The wolf asked the bunny why he was so sad. The bunny said, "I can't find my tie anywhere. I need it to go to the party tonight!" The wolf looked all around but he couldn't find the bunny's tie either.

One day, a little girl was looking out of her window. She watched the valley below. It was all so big and the sky was so gray. The girl squealed with delight and jumped up and down. She loved exploring and being outside. So she ran down to the valley and looked around. Everywhere she went, she saw different animals.

Lily was a new girl in school. She did not speak the same language as the other kids. She felt sad and lonely. She wanted to play and make friends, but she did not know how. One day, she saw a boy with a big smile. His name was Sam. He came to her and said, "Hi, I am Sam. What is your name?"

Once upon a time, there was a special gun. It was very unique. One day, a little boy saw the special gun and he wanted to make it even better. He wanted to improve it. He thought and thought, but he could not come up with any ideas. He asked his dad and his dad said, "Maybe you can find a special feather to put in the gun."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside in the rain, but her mom always told her to wear her rain boots so her toes wouldn't get wet. One day, Lily forgot to wear her rain boots and her toes got very wet.

Once upon a time there was a curtain. It was so blue. The curtain was a special curtain. It could remind anyone of something. One day, a little girl saw the curtain. She was only three years old. She looked at the curtain and remembered something that made her smile. She wanted to remember more so she touched the curtain.

One morning, Sarah was getting ready for the day. She put on her favorite purple collar and couldn't wait to go outside and play. As she was walking, Sarah came across a bookstore in the neighborhood. Sarah had never been to the bookstore before, but she decided she would go inside and take a look.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Amy. She went out for a walk with her mum. Amy liked to wear a pretty sun hat, but she had lost it. The mum and Amy went to the shop to buy a new hat. They found a very nice cap, it was white and red. Amy was so excited to buy it.

Once there was a little girl. She loved having fun but was sometimes helpless when it was time to do things she didn't understand. One day, the little girl was given a thermometer. She did not know what it was but it was shiny and caught her eye. She asked her mom what it was used for and her mom said to value how hot or cold things are.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Ben and Lucy. They were very busy playing with their toys. Suddenly, Ben made a silly face and Lucy started to laugh! She laughed and laughed until tears were in her eyes. But then Ben thought of an idea. He said to Lucy, "I know a funny joke, but only if you stop laughing!". Lucy stopped and listened.

Tim was a kind boy. Each day he would visit a big stone in the garden. He would climb onto it and polish it with a cloth. He did this every day, but he didn't know why. One day, his mum asked him why he polished the stone. Tim told her that he liked how it looked afterwards. His mum smiled and told him to keep at it.

Mum and Dad were in the kitchen, preparing dinner. "What are we making?" asked Dad. "I am making a modern dinner," said Mum. Dad smiled, "What is it?" "It's broccoli," said Mum. Dad's eyes widened, "Let me do it, then." Dad got to work, chopping and prepping the broccoli.

Once upon a time, there was a fat fish who lived in a big lake. He loved to swim around all day long and eat lots of yummy food. One day, a wise old turtle came to warn the fish that a big, mean bird was coming to catch him. The fish didn't listen to the turtle's warning and continued to swim around, thinking everything was okay.

Anna and Ben were playing in the park with their toys. They saw a big dog running towards them. The dog was friendly and licked their faces. Anna and Ben laughed and petted the dog. "Look, he has a bone in his mouth!" Ben said. "Where did he get it?" Anna looked at the bone. It was white and hard.

Once upon a time, there was an old lady who lived in a big house. She was very old and everyone called her "elderly". One day, she saw something strange appear in her garden. It was a little bird! The bird was very colorful and it made the old lady very happy. But then, the old lady heard a loud noise.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went outside to play in the rain. She splashed in all the puddles and got very wet. When she came inside, her mom said, "Lily, you're all wet! Let's dry you off." As her mom was drying her off, Lily noticed that her shoes had left marks on the floor.

Once upon a time there was a castle. Inside the castle was a funny king. He asked everyone who came to his castle a funny question. One day a 3-year-old child visited the castle and the funny king asked the child a funny question. The child looked confused and didn't know the answer.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play games. But Sara is bossy. She always wants to win. She tells Tom what to do. One day, they play hopscotch. Sara draws the squares with chalk. She says, "I go first. You go last." She hops on one foot. She throws the stone. She lands on the last square.

Once upon a time, there was a gray owl. The owl lived in a big tree with lots of leaves. Every day, the owl would fly around and look for food. Sometimes, the owl would catch a mouse and store it in their nest. One day, the owl saw a little girl walking in the woods. The girl was lost and scared.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was looking for something special. She looked around in the grass and there she found an ant. The ant was so small and it moved so quickly! The little girl was so excited that she decided to follow it. The ant led her to an apple tree. In the tree, the ant found a sweet apple.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lily. Lily wanted to go to the farmer's market. Her mummy said, "Ok, but you have to stay close and stay safe, ok?" Lily nodded and off they went. At the market, Lily saw many wonderful things, such as apples, pears and corn. She saw that the corn was growing very deep. It looked delicious!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat candy all day long. One day, her mom told her to stop eating candy and go outside to play. But Lily was feeling lazy and didn't want to move. Lily's mom opened the window to let some fresh air in. Suddenly, a bird flew inside the house and landed on the candy jar.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Anna who loved to swing. Every day she would go to the playground and swing all day long! One day, when Anna went to the playground, she saw something strange. All the stuff she usually used to swing was gone! Anna was so sad that she almost cried. Suddenly, Anna saw her friend Tom.

Once upon a time, there was a small fish. One day, the fish went swimming in the big ocean. It had lots of fun and saw many interesting things. Suddenly, a big fish came and tried to catch the small fish. The small fish was scared! But the small fish was very fast and was able to get away.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to skip and play in the meadow. One day, Benny saw a beautiful velvet ribbon on the ground. He picked it up and put it on his neck. Benny felt very proud of his new ribbon. The next day, Benny went to play in the meadow again.

Molly was sitting in her chair looking out the window. She saw a driver pull up in a big red car. Molly had never seen anything so big and shiny before. The driver was fit. He opened the door and stepped out of the car. He leaned against the car and stretched his legs. Molly watched as the driver walked around the car and opened the hood.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to walk with her mommy in the park. One day, they went for a walk and saw a cute little puppy. Lily asked her mommy, "Can we add the puppy to our family?" Her mommy said, "Let's ask the owner if the puppy is for sale."

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to eat yogurt every day. He thought it was very yummy. One day, Timmy's mom bought a new kind of yogurt. It was called "strawberry yogurt". Timmy thought it was just an ordinary yogurt, but it tasted very good. One day, Timmy wanted to try something new.

Once upon a time, a little girl had a goal. She wanted to find a mysterious thing. One day, she decided to go searching for it. She looked and looked, but she couldn't find it. Suddenly, the girl found a very curious item! It looked old and had many faces. She decided to replace her goal with this new item.

Once upon a time, there was a famous duck. All of the other animals in the forest wanted to be like her. Every day, the duck would take a long walk. She enjoyed enjoying the beautiful sights. One day, the duck came across a pond. It looked very safe so she decided to take a pause and take a swim. She felt so happy splashing around in the water.

Lila and Sam are friends. They like to play together. One day, they go to the library with their moms. They see a big book with many pictures. The book is about nations. "Nations are places where people live," Lila's mom says. "They have different names, colors, and shapes." Lila and Sam look at the book.

Once upon a time, there was a poor girl. She had only a few belongings in her room. One of them was an old ornament. Every day she looked at the ornament, but it never made her happy. Instead, it made her frown. One day, the girl's mom came into the room with a surprise. She had bought a new and shiny ornament!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a big pot in her house. Her mom told her, "Do not touch the pot, it is dangerous." One day, Lucy saw a cat playing near the pot. She wanted to play too. She forgot what her mom said and went to the pot. The cat jumped on the pot and it started to shake.

One day, Bud and his mommy were playing in the park. They gathered around a big tree. Bud asked his mommy, "What are we gonna do?" His mommy smiled and said "We are going to make some funny faces!" Bud loved funny faces and his mouth got so big that his mommy started to giggle. Bud said, "Let's do something else now."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys and going outside to play. One day, Lily's mom told her they were going to receive a special package in the mail. Lily was excited and asked, "What's in the package, mommy?" Her mom replied, "It's a surprise, but I think you'll like it."

Once there was a mom and a dad who wanted to have a picnic. They had all the stuff they needed and wanted to have a nice time outside. Mom and Dad were organized and put all the food in a basket. Next, they had to find a good spot to have the picnic and they hoped to find a perfect spot.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play in their room. They had a big mattress on the floor that they used as a trampoline. They would jump and bounce and laugh on the mattress, but they had to be careful not to hit the ceiling or the walls. One day, their mom told them to stop jumping and get ready for lunch. She said she had a surprise for them.

Once there was a good girl called Rose. One day, Rose wanted to play a game of hide and seek. She asked her mama if they could play, and her mama said yes, so they got started. First Rose had to hide. She closed her eyes and started counting. Suddenly, she had a great idea. She opened her eyes and saw a rose bush in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a big family who loved their television very much. It made them laugh and feel happy. One day, the family heard a loud crash. The television had broken! The old screen had a big crack in it. The mom was very sad. Dad said he would help repair it. He got some tools and tried to fix it.

Lily and Tom are playing in the living room. They see an old folder on the shelf. It is brown and has many papers inside. "Let's look at the folder," Lily says. "Maybe it has something fun." "Okay," Tom says. "But we have to be careful. It is very high." They get a chair and put it near the shelf.

Once upon a time, there was a house. It was very beautiful. Every day, a little girl named Lucy would go and balance on the house's steps. She would stay there for hours and have fun. One day, Lucy went to the house like she always did. But this time, she noticed it was in bad shape. The steps were creaky and the paint was chipped.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She was very hungry. Mia wanted to find something yummy to eat. So, she went for a walk in the park. In the park, Mia saw a big ice-cream truck. The truck had many colors and lots of ice-cream. Mia was happy to see the ice-cream truck.

Once upon a time there was a puppy who lived in a purple office. He was very lonely and often wished he could have some friends. One day, a man heard the puppy's cries and rushed in to rescue him. The man took the puppy out of the office, and the puppy was so happy to get outside.

Once upon a time, there was a poor family. The sky was grey and it started to rain. Mum and Dad wanted to make sure the family was safe and warm, so they asked the children to stay inside. Once upon a time, there were two kids. The first kid was very happy and always laughing and running around. The second kid was very anxious. They were the best of friends and liked to do everything together. One day, the anxious kid found an old box. He was sure it had something special inside so he asked his friend, the happy kid, to help him open it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars and trucks all day long. One day, Timmy's mom cooked some yummy food for dinner. But while cooking, she accidentally burned it and smoke came out of the kitchen. Timmy saw the smoke and said, "Mommy, what's that?"

Once upon a time there was a person who was very important. She loved to dress up and looked very pretty. Today the person was dressing for a special occasion. The person tried on many dresses, but none felt quite right. Then she put on an old dress that hadn't been worn in a long time. She looked at herself in the mirror and smiled, feeling very important.

Once upon a time, there was an old silver dragon who lived at the top of a huge mountain. Every morning, the dragon would wake up, spread its wings and roar so loud that it could be heard all around the mountains. All of the other animals and birds in the area were scared of the dragon's loud roar.

Lily loved to read books. She had many books in her room. Some books had pictures, some books had words. She liked both kinds. But her favorite book was a novel. A novel was a big book with many words and a long story. Lily's novel was about a princess and a dragon and a knight. She read it every night before bed.

George loved spending time with his friends. Every day they would play together and have lots of fun. Today they were walking in the park. Suddenly, George heard a whistle in the distance. He turned around and saw a lazy dog lazily walking towards them. The dog was carrying a jar of cocoa in its mouth.

Tom and Anna like to play in the park. They have a ball and a kite. They throw the ball to each other and run after the kite. They are happy. One day, they see a big animal in the park. It has orange and black fur and sharp teeth. It is a tiger. Tom and Anna are scared. They do not know the tiger.

Lily liked to play with her doll. She named her doll Anna and gave her a pink dress and a hat. Lily and Anna did everything together. They had tea parties, read books and sang songs. One day, Lily saw a new girl in the park. She had a doll too, but her doll was different. Her doll had long black hair and a red dress.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to watch his favourite team play. He had a big fan that he would bring to every game. One day, while Timmy was watching the game, he noticed that the sky was getting dark. He said to his mom, "Mommy, it looks like it's going to rain soon."

Once there was a little girl, her name was Mia. She was three years old and loved to explore the world around her. Every day, Mia and her mom would take a walk in the park. One day, while they were walking, they saw a patch of grass full of daisies. Mia was so excited and ran over to them.

Once upon a time, there were some friends who liked to celebrate. They all wore happy clothes and brought exciting toys. One day, they decided to have a party. They used their weapons to make some tasty treats. The nosy neighbour saw their celebration and wanted to join. They happily said yes and the party would start soon. The friends cheered and ran around.

Tom is a dog. He likes to run and play with his owner, Sam. Sam is a boy. He likes to throw a ball and Tom likes to catch it. They are happy. One day, Tom and Sam go to the park. They see many other dogs and people. Some dogs are big and some are small. Some are loud and some are quiet.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved flowers and always wanted to see them bloom. One day, she planted some seeds in her garden and waited for them to grow. As the days went by, Lily noticed that her flowers were not growing as she expected. She watered them every day, but they still looked sad and droopy.

Tim and Sue were hungry. They saw a big bag of oats on a distant farm. They wanted to eat some oats. They ran to the farm and looked for the farmer. They did not see him. "Let's steal some oats," Tim said. "The farmer will not know." Sue nodded. They opened the bag and took some oats. They put them in their pockets.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sarah. Sarah was a very enthusiastic girl. Every day, Sarah would go outside and explore. While she was exploring, Sarah saw something - a mysterious barrel. Sarah was so curious that she just had to take a closer look. She walked up to the barrel and tapped it with her hands. It felt heavy. She wondered what was inside.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to run and play outside. He would feel so happy when he could run fast and jump high. One day, Timmy entered a race and he ran as fast as he could. He was so happy when he won a shiny medal! It was so pretty and he felt proud.

Lily and Max were hungry. They wanted to eat pasta for dinner. Mom said she would make pasta with cheese and sauce. Lily and Max helped Mom in the kitchen. They poured water in a big pot. They put salt in the water. They waited for the water to boil. When the water was hot and bubbly, Mom said, "Be careful, the water is very hot.

Mark was a gifted three year old. One day, he decided to explore the nearby woods. On his adventure, he came across a magical tree. Its branches were filled with bright, colourful fruit. Mark was excited. He wanted to take some fruit, but he also felt that taking it without permission was wrong. He thought to himself, "I'll ask the tree first."

Ben and Mia are playing with magnets. They have a big box of magnets in different shapes and colors. They like to stick them together and make funny things. Ben makes a car with four round magnets for wheels and a long magnet for the body. He shows it to Mia and says, "Look, I made a car. Do you like it?"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to admire the world around her. One day while out exploring, she came across a beautiful table. The table was made of wood and had intricate carvings all around. The little girl was so impressed with the table she bent down to take a closer look. She noticed the table was flexible.

Once upon a time, there was a sunny day. Joe and his mom went to the park to play. "Look! Everyone is flying kites," Joe said. "Yes, isn't it wonderful?" said his mom. Joe wanted to join in on the fun. His mom said, "Sure, let's go!". Soon, Joe was running around with a colorful kite in the sky.

Once upon a time there was a silly little boy. He wanted to go for a walk. So he put on his shoes and started to go. He walked and walked until he reached the sea. The sea was very big and he couldn't see the other side. He was so excited to see the sea. He put his hand in the water and it was cold.

Daniel was a very loyal boy. He was always polite, sweet and helpful. One day, his granny invited him to come visit. She told him that she had something special to show him! Daniel was so excited, he put on his shoes and flew out of the door.

Tom and Sue liked to play with their toys in the dark. They had a flashlight that could glow in different colors. They liked to make shadows and shapes on the wall with the flashlight. One day, they found a newspaper in the trash. They thought it would be fun to use the newspaper as a screen for their flashlight show. They took the newspaper to their room and turned off the light.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little bunny. The bunny lived in a forest and loved to hop around. One day, the bunny saw a track on the ground. It was a long and winding track. The bunny wanted to follow the track and see where it went. So, the bunny hopped along the track. As the bunny hopped, it saw a friendly squirrel.

Sara liked to test her mom. She did not want to wear the clothes that mom picked for her. She wanted to wear her pink dress every day. Mom said no, you need to wear different clothes. Some clothes are for cold days, some are for hot days, some are for playing, some are for going out. But Sara was persistent.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing at the beach and building sandcastles. He would spend hours digging and shaping the sand. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a very important job. She asked him to help her find matching socks for his little sister. Timmy looked and looked, but he couldn't find any that matched.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Timmy and Lisa. Timmy was a three year old and Lisa was five. One day they were playing in the park when they heard a noise. "What's that noise?" asked Lisa. "I don't know," said Timmy. The noise was getting louder and louder. Then, Lisa shouted "Look! A clock!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went outside to play without dressing warmly. It was very cold outside, but Lily didn't want to wear her coat. She thought she would be fine. But as she played, Lily started to feel very cold. Her hands and feet were numb, and she shivered all over.

Once upon a time there was a little old man. He loved to wander around his village. One day he decided to wander away from his village and as he was walking he saw something strange. He saw two armies of soldiers fighting each other. They were shouting and the ground was shaking. The little old man was scared and he started to run away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to skip outside in the sunshine and sing songs. One day, she found a note on the ground. It was an open envelope with a message inside. "Hey Lily, let's meet at the park today!" the note read. Lily was so excited to meet her friend at the park.

Bobby was an impatient 3-year-old. Whenever his mom asked him to do something, he wanted to do it right away. One day, Bobby's mom asked him to put a cloth in the washing machine. Bobby did not want to take his time doing it, so he decided to jog over to the machine. As Bobby was jogging, he spotted a ball and got distracted.

Jimmy had never seen anything like it! He was in the garden with his mom, and they had come across a strange orange squash. His mom was helpful and showed Jimmy where to hold it, and he stepped back in amazement at the size of it. Jimmy just watched, wondering what was going to happen to the squash.

Once upon a time there was an old bear. He was sad because he had been feeling lonely for a long time. Every day, he went to the same spot in the woods and sat there in silent loneliness. One day, a little rabbit came by and noticed the old bear's sadness. They started to talk and the rabbit asked, "Why are you so sad, old bear?"

Alice was a gifted little girl. She often stared intently at the door of her house, wide-eyed and wondering what was on the other side. She sometimes asked her parents, â€œWhatâ€™s behind the door?â€ but they never gave her a straight answer. One day, Alice finally plucked up the courage to open the door and find out for herself.

Once upon a time there was a girl called June and a boy called Joe. They were very good friends, and Joe always looked after June. One day Joe and June went to the park to play together. They laughed, ran and enjoyed the day. Joe said to June, "If we ever get married, I will give you a picture of us".

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved shrimp. He always asked his mom to buy him some when they went to the store. One day, Timmy and his mom went to the store. Timmy saw some shrimp and asked his mom if she could buy it for him. His mom said yes and they put the shrimp in their cart.

Once upon a time, there was a red bird. The bird liked to fly high in the sky and sing songs. One day, the bird saw a shiny bow on the ground. It picked up the bow with its beak and flew away. The bird flew to a tree and saw a squirrel. The squirrel wanted the bow, but the bird didn't want to give it away.

There were two friends who were playing in a park one day. The sun was shining and the grass was dry. The friends started running around and playing tag. One friend tripped and fell on her knee. It started hurting and she started to cry. Her friend said, "Let's go to the pond and get some water." They ran to the pond and dipped their hands in the cold water.

Once upon a time, there was a small child who loved the universe. She was curious and wanted to explore it no matter what. But her parents wouldn't permit her. They said the universe was too dangerous and didn't want her to get hurt. The small child was sad but still grateful to her parents for caring. She followed their rules and stayed indoors most of the time.

Once there was a little girl called Lyla. She was only three years old, but she was very curious about the world. One day, she decided to go on a journey to find out more. As she walked around, Lyla saw many weird things. She saw bubble-gum trees and sparkly rivers. She even saw a fox with two tails!

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo loved to swim in the ocean with his friends. One day, they saw a beautiful dancer on the beach. She was wearing a pretty dress and dancing to music. Nemo and his friends wanted to join in, but they didn't know how to dance. Suddenly, a naughty seagull swooped down and stole the dancer's hat.

Tim and Mia are friends. They like to play games. Today they play a game with cards. Tim has a red card and Mia has a blue card. They turn the cards over and see who has the bigger number. "Look, I have a six!" Tim says. "You have a four. I win!" Mia is sad. She does not like to lose.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat blueberries because they were her favorite fruit. One day, her mom took her to a beautiful garden where there were lots of blueberry bushes. Lily was so happy and picked lots of blueberries to eat. Suddenly, Lily saw a butterfly flying around and she wanted to catch it.

Mum was in the kitchen cooking. She had a great big pot and she was putting some ingredients in. First she added some tuna. It looked very yummy. She also added lots of other stuff. She stirred it all together and it smelled delicious. Next she put the pot on the stove to cook. She stirred it every now and then to make sure everything cooked evenly.

Once there was a girl. She was very sad and she was weeping. Her best friend was a tall pole. Every day she would come and weep beside it. One day her friend the pole asked her, "Why do you keep on weeping?" The girl answered sadly, "My beloved book is lost and I cannot find it."

Once upon a time, there was an enormous jar. Imagine the biggest jar you could ever think of and that's how big it was! It was so enormous and magical that it could fit a lot of things inside. One day, a tiny and brave rabbit named Max hopped over to the jar. He looked inside and saw lots of fascinating items.

Once upon a time there were two young friends - Sam and Bill. Sam was very different from Bill; he had more spot on his skin and he talked less than Bill did. One day Sam and Bill went on an adventure. They numbered off the things they saw and said them together. Sam said the first number - one! They saw a big red flower and laughed.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Molly. She liked to be very obedient. Every day, Molly's mum would give her a cookie and tell her to be nice to her friends. One day, Molly was playing with her friends when her friends started to cry. Molly was upset too. She didn't know what she could do to help.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was very adventurous. He liked to play outside with his friends. One day, he saw a big ice cream truck. It had many cones. Tim wanted one. Tim went to the ice cream truck and said, "Can I have a cone, please?"

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Rocky. She was very careful. One day, Rocky wanted to go on an adventure. She grabbed her big bag and her salt shaker and went outside. Rocky started walking. She saw a big rock and said, "This would be a good place to rest." She sat on the rock and took out her salt shaker.

Tommy was playing in his backyard. He liked to bury treasures in the ground and he had just purchased a shiny steel box. He was happily opening the box when his mommy called him inside. He left the box in the garden and went to check in with his mom. All of a sudden, he heard an eerie noise coming from the yard.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a red vest that she loved to wear everywhere she went. One day, while she was playing outside, she saw a little bird that looked helpless. It couldn't fly and it was just sitting on the ground. Lily wanted to help the bird, so she gently poked it with her finger to see if it was okay.

Once upon a time there was a pink bear who loved to sit in the sunshine. She would lay down in the grass and feel the warm, spring breeze against her fur. One day, a fire began in the forest near her home. The pink bear was very scared and she began to run away from the flames. Suddenly, she noticed a big tree with a big, hollow trunk.

Jake was very excited--today he was going to buy a fancy alarm for his bedroom. When he arrived at the store, he began the search for the perfect alarm. After a few minutes of browsing, he found a beautiful alarm with a lot of bells and whistles! He quickly purchased it and headed home. "Mom!" Jake shouted when he returned.

Tim and Mia are playing with their toys in the living room. They have a lot of fun with their cars, dolls, and blocks. But they also make a big mess on the floor and the couch. "Look, Tim, I have a laser!" Mia says, holding a flashlight. She turns it on and off, making a red dot on the wall.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl. She wanted to take a wagon and explore the world. So she took off! Everywhere she went, she was kind and respectful. One day, she found a friendly puppy. She wanted to take him along, but the puppy had a leash and looked as if he belonged to someone.

Once there was a nice little girl. She liked to clap her hands together and make funny noises. One day an emergency happened. She was very scared and started to cry. Then her mom came. She bent down and gave her a hug. Then she started to clap her hands. The little girl saw this, so she started to clap too.

Once there was a little girl called Julie. She was three years old and lived with her mum and dad. One day, Julie and Daddy were in the bathroom together. Daddy was washing his hands with soap. "You want to pull the soap out of the dispenser, Julie?" Daddy asked. Julie nodded and reached up to pull the soap. But it felt funny.

Once upon a time, there was a clever fox. He liked to play tricks on the other animals. One day, he planned to steal some food from the farm. But the farmer saw him and chased him away. The fox was very sad. He didn't have any food to eat. He thought and thought about what to do. Finally, he came up with a new plan.

Once upon a time there was an honest boy. His name was Tom. Tom liked to play with a bottle he had. He hugged it tight and kissed it every day. One day, Tom was playing with the bottle outside when he saw a puppy. He thought the pupy was so cute, so he picked it up and hugged it tight.

Once upon a time, there was a cute pink pony. She was the prettiest pony ever, with her soft pink fur. Every day she would walk around the big field near her house, eating the sweet grass. One day, while she was walking around, she saw a giant juicy apple. She stopped and couldn't help but take a bite. The apple was so tasty!

Once upon a time, there lived a brave little boy with his family. One day the little boy got a funny box with a battery inside. The box had some buttons, and when the boy pressed one, something amazing happened - a toy car appeared! The boy was so excited and he played with it all day long. That night something strange happened.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived on a farm. She loved playing outside and the animals were her best friends. Whenever she was looking for something fun to do, she always joined the sheep. One day, the little girl wanted to join the sheep, but instead of the usual fun game she usually played, the sheep would not let her come close.

Sara and Lily were best friends. They liked to play with dolls and draw pictures. One day, Sara found a shiny bracelet in the park. It had many colors and made a nice sound when she moved it. "Look, Lily, what I found!" Sara said, showing her the bracelet. "Wow, it is so pretty! Can I see it?" Lily asked, reaching for it.

Once upon a time there was a stack of blocks. The blocks seemed to be talking to each other. They were excited because they were getting creative. The blocks were stacking on top of each other and making different shapes. The stack became taller and taller, until it was almost as tall as the room!

Little Sam was feeling very adventurous. He wanted to explore the world around him, but he was a bit scared. He nervously stared out his bedroom window. He gazed at the bright and hot sunshine outside. He knew it was time for him to be brave and go outside. Suddenly, Sam spotted something in the garden! It was a huge, brown and fuzzy caterpillar!

Lila and Ben are friends. They like to play soccer in the park. Lila is good at kicking the ball. Ben is good at catching the ball. They have fun together. One day, they see a big sign in the park. It says: "Soccer Team Tryouts". Lila and Ben want to join the soccer team. They run to the sign and read more.

Once upon a time there was a humble desk. It was lonely and did not have anyone to play with. One day it saw a man and a woman walking by. They were so happy they were going to marry. The desk was so excited and wanted to join the fun! So the desk asked them if it could marry too. They laughed and said yes!

Once upon a time, there was a tall giraffe named Jerry. Jerry was very hungry and wanted to eat some tuna for lunch. But Jerry didn't know how to get the tuna. So, Jerry asked his friend, the monkey, if he could send him some tuna. The monkey said, "Sure, Jerry! I will send you some tuna right away!"

Tom and Sue like to play with dough. They have many colors of dough. They can make animals and cars and houses with dough. They have fun with dough. One day, Tom and Sue see a big bowl of dough on the table. They think it is for them. They want to play with it. They do not know it is for bread. They do not ask mom or dad.

Mia and Ben are twins. They like to play outside in nature. They see trees, flowers, birds and bugs. Sometimes they find sticks and stones to make things. One day, they go to the park with Mom. They see a big pond with ducks and fish. Mia wants to feed the ducks. She has some bread in her bag. Ben wants to catch the fish.

Jessie was given a box of pastels. It was a big box and it had lots of colours. She was so excited! She carefully opened the box and saw all the beautiful, fragile pastels. She wanted to take them outside and make pictures with them, but her mum refused. Mum said the outside was too windy and that the pastels would be too fragile.

The little girl was around three years old and she liked to play with her soft chalk. She found it very fun to draw big circles and colors on the sidewalk. One day, while she was playing outside, her mother approached her. She asked the little girl what she was doing but she just looked up at her and smiled. "Do you understand mommy?"

Once upon a time a little boy was walking around town with his mom. All of a sudden a naughty little squirrel came running up and started to throw a post around. The little boy was scared and he ran over to hide behind his mom. His mom then said to him that being naughty was not nice and that he should never throw things around.

Once upon a time there was a giant. The giant was very big and tall. He was walking around the towns. He didn't like to stop. One day the giant got very upset. He was mad and stomped his feet. He was so upset that he didn't know what to do. Suddenly a little girl walked up to him. She said, "Please don't be upset.

Once upon a time, there was a man who was bald. He loved to eat popcorn. One day, he went to the store to buy some popcorn. There were many kinds of popcorn to choose from. He chose the one with butter on it. He went home and put the popcorn in the microwave. It smelled so good!

Tom and Sue were brother and sister. They liked to play in the big house where they lived. One day, they found a door that was locked. They wondered what was behind it. "Let's try to open it," Tom said. He took a key from his pocket. He had found it in the garden. He put it in the lock and turned it.

Once upon a time there was a graceful bird. She was so graceful, everyone in the land admired her. One day she set out on a long journey. On her way, she found a beach full of beautiful sand. She stopped to admire it and decided to fill up her wings with sand. After a while, she felt it was time to return home.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lily. Lily loved candy and wanted to eat it all the time. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a big bag of candy. At first, Lily was very excited about the sweet treats. But when she opened the bag, Lily saw that the candy looked strange. It was too bright and shiny!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved animals and wanted to go to the zoo. His mom said they could go if they were safe. Timmy was excited and happy. Mom packed some snacks and drinks in a bag. Timmy held the bag and walked with his mom. They saw many animals at the zoo. There were monkeys, lions, and elephants.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy car that she loved to play with, but one day it broke. She asked her mom if she could fix it. Mom said, "Let's take it to the toy store and see if they can repair it." So, they went to the toy store and talked to the man there.

Jenny was a 3 year old who loved to slide. She had a special slide near her house that she visited every weekend. Today, she was wearing her favorite polka dot dress as she made her way to the slide. When she reached the slide, she was surprised to see some cauliflower at the top. It was a strange sight, so she decided to try it.

Once upon a time, there was an amazing octopus who lived in the sea. He liked to pour the water in and out of its tank while it played. One day, the octopus decided that it wanted to explore the world outside of the tank. It gathered all its courage and jumped out of the tank into the cool, refreshing water.

Once upon a time, there was a man who loved to play with toys. He had a big collection of toy cars and planes. One day, he went to a store and saw a toy that he really wanted. It was a fake robot that could move and talk. The man bought the toy and took it home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Maisy. She was playing in her bedroom when she saw a big chest in the corner. Maisy was very curious, so she walked over to the chest and opened it. Inside she found lots of toys! Maisy was so excited that she grabbed the toys and started to play. Suddenly, her older brother Oliver burst into the room.

Once upon a time, there was a birdie. The birdie loved to fly up high in the sky. One day, the birdie decided to soar even higher than before. It flapped its wings and went up, up, up! The birdie felt so happy to be soaring in the sky. But then, the birdie got sick. It had a bad tummy ache and felt very sad.

Once there was a famous dish. Everyone wanted to try it. But it was very hard to make. One day a man called John decided to make the famous dish. He got all the ingredients he needed and he cooked the dish. When it was done, the man smiled and said "wow, this dish looks amazing!" He put it into the oven so it could dry.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the forest near her house. One day, she met a silly rabbit who was hopping around. "Hello, rabbit. Why are you so foolish?" asked Lily. "I'm not foolish, I just love to laugh and have fun!" replied the rabbit.

Sara and Ben liked to watch cartoons on TV. They liked the same cartoons, like the one with the funny dog and the one with the brave girl. They also liked to play together and share their toys. They were good friends. One day, Sara said to Ben, "Do you want to marry me?" Ben was surprised. He did not know what marry meant.

Once upon a time, there was a big white yacht. It was very clean. A boy named Jack was on the yacht. He wanted to keep it clean. Jack grabbed a bucket of water and a sponge. He started scrubbing the deck of the yacht. Jack worked hard and scrubbed until the entire deck was shining. He was so proud!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go camping with her family. One day, while they were at camp, Lily found a cute little bunny. She wanted to hold it, so she squeezed it too hard. The bunny got scared and ran away.

Ben likes to play with his cars. He has many cars of different colors and sizes. He makes them zoom and crash on the floor. He pretends he is a driver and a mechanic. One day, his dad has to go to work. His dad wears a suit and a tie. He looks very smart. He tells Ben to be good and to have fun.

Ben and Sam are friends. They both like to play with scooters. They have red scooters that go fast. One day, they see a new scooter in the park. It is blue and shiny. It has big wheels and a horn. "Wow, look at that scooter!" Ben says. "It is great. I want it." "Me too," Sam says.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to sing and dance, and he would always sing loudly when he was happy. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy wanted to play with Timmy's microphone, but Timmy didn't want to share it because he loved it so much.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to watch TV. He would watch it all day and feel very happy. His favorite thing to watch was funny animals. Tim would laugh and think about the animals when he was not watching TV. One day, Tim's TV broke. It would not turn on. Tim was very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very excited because he was going to ride on a big train. But when he got to the station, he saw that his ticket was broken! Timmy's mommy tried to fix the ticket, but she couldn't. Then, a kind man with glasses came up to them.

Jim and Jane were very happy. They had a lovely package to open! Jim took one end of the package and Jane took the other. Together, they pulled and the package opened. Inside were lots and lots of things. Jim and Jane were so excited and laughed out loud. Jim started to sort the things into two piles.

Jane and her mom were in the zoo. Jane loved going to the zoo. She always liked to look at the animals. Suddenly, they saw an elephant. Jane was so happy and excited to see it. "Mom, can we go and see the elephant?" Jane asked. Her mom replied, "Yes, of course." So, they both went and stood in front of the elephant.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was very obedient and always did what her mama said. One day, Lucy was playing outside and she started to feel hot. Her mama said, "Come inside Lucy, it's time to dress". So she went inside and put on her favourite dress. It was so pretty and blue with lots of flowers on it.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called John. John was 3 years old. He loved playing games with his friends and his toy dinosaurs. One day, John wanted to play something new. He opened his bookshelf and saw something he had never seen before - an old book with a fragile page. He was excited and he wanted to learn what was on the page.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She was only three years old and had a beautiful voice. One day, she sang a beautiful song out loud. Her parents listened and smiled. But then, something terrible happened. The little girl suddenly stopped singing. She had seen a fake bird on the windowsill. She was so scared that she ran away.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. Her name was Magu. Magu was three years old. One day, Magu was walking down the street. The street was very long and bumpy. Magu wanted to rock to make the ride more fun. Magu saw an old man on the street. She said, "Hi Mister! Can you help me rock?"

Mia loves chocolate. She likes to eat it every day. But her mom says too much chocolate is not good. It can make her sick and weigh too much. Mia does not want to be sick or weigh too much. She wants to be healthy and happy. One day, Mia sees a big box of chocolate on the table. It is a gift from her grandma.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who always wanted to jump on the carpet. She was very weak and couldn't jump very far, but she wanted to try again and again. Her mom cheerfully said to her, "If you practice hard, you can jump further!" So the little girl went to the carpet and she jumped, and she jumped, and she jumped.

Lily and Tom are twins. They like to play and share. But they also like cake. Mom made a big cake for their birthday. It has pink and blue frosting and sprinkles. Mom says, "Wait for the guests, then we can cut the cake." Lily and Tom nod. They go to the living room and play with their toys. But they keep looking at the cake.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. Her mum and dad were worried about the weather, because it was raining heavily. But the little girl was excited and wanted to play outside. "Mum, can I go outside?" the little girl asked. "No," her mum said. "The weather is too bad, so you must stay inside." The little girl refused to stay inside.

Once upon a time, there was a rich family that lived in a large house and had lots of money. One day the family was decorating their house, so they called in a decorator. The decorator went to their house and started to measure everything to make sure it was just right.

Mum was at the park with her little girl. She had brought a big red balloon with her. Mum took the balloon and explained to her daughter what it was. The little girl was so excited. Mum said, "This is a balloon. It's like a toy that you can play with." The little girl started jumping around with the balloon in her hands.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, especially his toy car. One day, Timmy was playing with his car outside when he accidentally dropped it in the grass. He searched and searched but couldn't find it. Timmy was sad because he loved his toy car. But then, he remembered that he had a magnet at home.

Timmy likes to play with his furry toy bear. He hugs it and talks to it and pretends it is his friend. But one day, his bear gets very dirty. Timmy sees mud and juice and jam on his bear's fur. He feels sad and wants to make his bear clean again. He asks his mom if he can wash his bear in the sink.

Jack had a new spoon. He was so excited to spend time with it. He ran around the house with his spoon in his hand. Jack's mom watched him and laughed. Jack loved to use his spoon to eat his food. He pretended it was a pretend boat or a magic wand. He would even use the spoon to dig in the dirt with his friends.

One day, a blue fox was walking in the forest. He was very hungry and wanted to find some food. He saw a big tree with many red fruits. He thought they looked yummy and wanted to eat them. He jumped and jumped, but he could not reach the fruits. He saw a bird sitting on a branch. The bird was eating a fruit and singing a song.

Andy was a little boy. One summer, he went to visit his grandma's farm. Andy was so excited to see the farm. He saw many animals, like cows and chickens. The farm was so pretty. He loved looking at the fields of green grass and the bright yellow hay bales. Grandma asked Andy if he wanted to help. He said yes!

Lila and Tom were friends who liked to play in the park. They had a secret spot under a big tree, where they made a fort with sticks and leaves. They pretended they were wealthy kings and queens who lived in a castle. One day, a new boy came to the park. His name was Max and he had a shiny bike and a backpack full of toys.

Lily and Sam were twins. They had a birthday soon. They wanted to celebrate with their friends. They asked Mom and Dad to help them. Mom and Dad were thoughtful. They made a big cake with candles. They invited Lily and Sam's friends to the park. They brought balloons and games and snacks. Lily and Sam were happy. They wore party hats and blew whistles.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with cardboard boxes and make houses out of them. One day, Lily's mom asked her to get dressed because they were going to the park. Lily put on her warm coat and her favorite hat and they went out. At the park, Lily saw her friend Max playing with a big cardboard box.

Once there was a little boy who was trying to guess what he saw in the sky. He squinted and peered into the horizon. Suddenly, he saw a black shape whizzing across the sky. He wondered what it was and knew he had to find out. The little boy ran to his dad and asked, "What is that?"

Once there was a little girl who loved to dress up. Every day she would choose something different to wear. Today she was getting ready for the gym. She chose a bright red shirt that she loved. She also picked out red shoes with sparkles on them. When it was time to go, the little girl's mom helped her dress. She put on her red shirt and tied her shoes.

Once upon a time there was a jolly bear who loved to explore. One day, the bear had a wonderful idea! He looked up to the sky and thought, "maybe I can come to the clouds!" He looked around and found a powerful machine that could help him reach the clouds. The bear hopped into the machine and pushed the buttons, and soon he was up in the sky.

Once there was a small girl. She loved to create. She wanted to make something special so she decided to create an umbrella. She looked for materials she could use. She found sticks and fabric. She used the sticks to make the frame of the umbrella and the fabric to cover it. She worked hard to put it together and when she finished her umbrella was ready!

Anna loved her velvet doll. It was her original toy, the first one she ever had. She liked to put the doll in her bed and hug it at night. The doll had a blue dress and yellow hair, and a smile on its face. One day, Anna went to the park with her mom and her doll. She saw a big slide and wanted to try it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her toy fan. Lily would turn the fan on and watch it spin round and round. One day, Lily's little brother, Max, came into her room. He saw the fan and was eager to play with it too. "Can I play with your fan, Lily?"

Lily liked to ride her bike. She had a pink bike with a bell and a basket. She put her doll and her magazine in the basket. She liked to look at the magazine. It had pictures of animals and flowers. One day, Lily rode her bike to the park. She saw a big slide and a swing. She wanted to play. She left her bike by a tree.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim lived in a small house with his mom and dad. They had a nice garden with a path. Tim liked to play on the path every day. One day, Tim saw his dad working in the garden. His dad was making the path modern. He was putting new stones on the path.

Once upon a time, in a big wood, there lived a blue bird. The blue bird had many friends. They liked to play together all day. The blue bird was very happy. One day, a big, mean bird came to the wood. The mean bird wanted to fight with the blue bird and his friends. The blue bird did not want to fight.

Once upon a time there was a mommy and daddy and their three year old daughter. She was playing in their backyard when she suddenly saw a sparkly bracelet poking out from under a rock. She got excited and said to her mommy, "Look! I found a bracelet!" Her mommy smiled and said, "That looks like a special bracelet. What do you want to do with it?"

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and balls. They live next to each other. They have a big yard with a fence. One day, Tom and Sam find a big hole in the fence. They see a dog on the other side. The dog is black and white. It has a collar with a name. The name is Spot.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Joe. He wanted to sail the seas. Joe was so envious of all the boats he would see as they traveled across the water. One day Joe's wish became true. He received a beautiful boat in the post. He was so excited and couldn't wait to use it. Joe went to the beach with his boat.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby little frog. He was hopping around near a pond when he noticed a rope. He hopped closer to the rope and for a long time he just looked at it. Suddenly, he decided to take a chance. He started to jump and eventually he caught the rope. Then he swung the rope and ended up with a big splash in the water!

Once upon a time, there was a big puddle of mud. It was very long and went on and on. A little girl wanted to pass through the mud to get to the other side. She asked her mom if she could try to pass, and her mom said yes. The little girl plopped right into the mud with a big splash and started to wiggle and squish along.

Once upon a time there was a curious little bird called Fluffy. Every morning Fluffy woke up very early and kept asking her parents, "What are we going to do today?" Today, Fluffy's parents decided that they were going to go and find an egg. As they went to look for eggs, they talked to Fluffy about being careful.

Once there was a girl who loved to drink juice. Every day she would go to the kitchen to get a glass of juice. Then one day she found a letter on the floor. It was very exciting and she couldn't wait to open it. When she opened it, a disgusting smell came out. She was very disappointed and started to cry.

Tommy did not like to go to the barber. He liked his hair long and messy. He did not want to sit still and let the barber cut his hair with scissors. He thought the barber was stupid and mean. One day, his mom said, "Tommy, you have to go to the barber today. Your hair is too long and dirty.

Once upon a time there was a white kangaroo. He love to hop around in the woods, where he could find delicious grass and fruits. One day the white kangaroo was feeling a bit curious, so he decided to ask a nearby bird for help. "Little bird," said the kangaroo, "I have a very important question for you". Once upon a time there was an orange river. It sparkled brightly in the sun and made the sky look very pretty. Then he snapped the stick in two.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Bob. Bob was three years old and loved olives. One day, he put an olive on the table. He knocked it and it disappeared! Bob was very surprised and asked his mum, "Where did the olive go?" His mum said, "It must have gone down the hole." Bob wondered what a hole was.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a hidden garden. It had a big fence around it. Inside the garden, there were many pretty flowers and tall trees. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a closet in her room where she kept all her toys and clothes. One day, Lily's mom asked her to clean her closet. Lily was upset because she didn't want to clean her closet.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his toys. One day, Tim was playing with his favorite toy, a small red car. He was having so much fun!
