Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and touch everything he saw. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to clean up his toys, but Timmy lied and said he already did. Later that day, Timmy's mom found his toys still scattered all over the floor.

The sea was very noisy. It made lots of loud sounds, rippling and crashing against the beach. Toby jumped out of bed one morning, and ran down to the beach. He wanted to go for a swim in the big blue ocean. But his mum said,"You mustn't go too far into the ocean. Stay close to the port, and don't go too deep."

Once there was a small mouse who wanted to be independent. He wanted to show everyone how brave and strong he was. So he decided to find a needle to prove it. So off he went in search of it, looking this way and that. Finally, he found a big, shiny needle in the grass. He was so proud of himself!

Anna liked to play in the garden with her mom. She liked to look at the flowers and smell them. She liked the red ones and the yellow ones and the pink ones. She liked to pick some and give them to her mom. One day, Anna saw a new flower in the garden. It was white and had many petals. It was very big and pretty.

Tom and Mia are playing in the snow. They make a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. They also make snowballs and throw them at each other. They laugh and have fun. "Watch out, Mia!" Tom says. He has a big snowball in his hand. He throws it at Mia, but she is quick. She picks up a big lid from a trash can.

Once upon a time there was a green frog. He was called Jimmy. Jimmy was always a bit lonely because he didn't have many friends. So every day he would go for a swim in the pond, hoping to make some new friends. One day, Jimmy was swimming and he saw something floating in the water. He swam closer and saw that it was a trap!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to help her with the laundry. Timmy didn't want to help because he wanted to play with his toys. But then, Timmy's mom showed him a funny shirt that she had just ironed.

Once upon a time, there was a little blue bird. The bird loved to fly and sing all day long. One day, the bird felt very dirty and wanted to bathe. It flew to a nearby pond and took a nice long bath. After the bath, the bird felt refreshed and happy. Later that day, the bird saw a big stack of blueberries.

Once upon a time, there was an old man who had a smelly coat. The coat was so smelly that it made the old man sneeze! The old man decided that he must fix his coat. He asked his friend, the tailor, for help. The tailor said he could remove the smelly stitches from the coat.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat sugar. One day, he found a big bag of sugar in the kitchen. Tim's mom saw him and said, "Stop, Tim! Too much sugar is not good for you." Later that day, Tim's mom went to the store.

Once upon a time there was a soldier. He liked to store his things in his special box. Every day, he would take something out of his box to play with. One day he took out his toy soldiers and began playing. He lined them up to pretend they were in a military parade. He was very playful, pretending to march them around the room.

Once upon a time there was a mummy and a daddy. They wanted to take their little baby on a surprise. So they put a helmet on the baby's head and took her to the beach! The sand was dirty and the water was murky. The baby was so excited to go in the water. But then she found something in the sand. It was a filthy helmet!

Once upon a time there were two friends, Mike and Jan, who wanted to go on an adventure. They wanted to explore a nearby mountain, but they were scared. They decided to ask an older person they knew to help them. They asked their tutor if he was available to take them to the mountain. He said yes, and they were so excited!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and pick flowers. One day, she found a shiny copper penny on the ground. It was so pretty and yellow! Lily put the penny in her pocket and continued to play. She ran around and laughed, but soon she got tired. She sat down on a bench and sighed.

One day, a big red bus was driving down the road. The bus was very clumsy and it would wobble and shake. The people on the bus were happy, but they would laugh when the bus wobbled. The bus driver saw a big door on the road. He thought it was strange, but he kept driving. When the bus got close to the door, it started to lock by itself!

Bernard was a brave tank driver. Every day, he drove his tank in a big field. One day, he saw something strange in the distance. He wanted to take a closer look, so he stopped the tank and carefully got out. As he crept closer, he saw a big animal. Bernard was scared! He paused and thought about what to do.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was only 3 years old. Sarah loved to sit under the sun. She found it so light and warm, and it made her happy. One day, Sarah decided she wanted to become a fairy. She wanted to fly and be able to do magical things. So Sarah waved her wand and wished with all her might.

Once there was a very rude little boy. He loved to race around with his friends, but often he was not very nice. One day, the boy wanted to go racing around the wheat fields. Tim and Sam were brothers. They liked to play with their toys and their dog. But they did not like to share. They always fought over who got the best toy or the most food. Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the wild forest near his house. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a sweater to wear because it was cold outside. Timmy didn't want to wear the sweater because it was too itchy. Timmy's mom said, "You have to wear the sweater so you don't get sick."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the mud. One day, Lily's mommy told her that she could have a successful garden if she planted some seeds. Lily didn't believe her mommy, but she wanted to try anyway. So, Lily put on her boots and went outside to find some mud.

One day, Mama and Papa had a quarrel. Mama was very angry at Papa. She put her fists on her hips and shouted. Papa stood up and shook his head. He didn't like being shouted at. He grabbed the little knob on the door and left. Mama was also leaving the room. But she was tidying up as she went.

Once upon a time, there was a great field. In this field there was a big tree. Every day, small animals would gather under the tree. One day, a little girl named Mia was playing in the field. Danny was three years old and he loved playing outside. He was playing with his hose on the hot summer day. He watered his mom's garden and made sure all the flowers had enough to drink. Once upon a time there was a cool clock. It had paws and it liked to jog. Every morning it would walk to the park with its friends and jog around. All the animals would cheer for the clock as it ran around the park. One day the clock was a bit late so it had to jog even faster! It managed to finish the race in time.

Mia and Sam liked to play on the beach. They made sand castles and looked for shells. They saw many flowers that grew near the water. They were pink and yellow and purple. Mia said, "Look, Sam, the flowers are blooming. They are so pretty." Sam nodded and picked one. He gave it to Mia. "Here, this is for you. You are my friend."

Once upon a time, there was a bright sun in the sky. It was a nice day to go outside and play. A girl named Sally wanted to have fun with her friends. She put on her shoes and tied them tight. She was ready to go. Sally found her friends playing in the park. They were laughing and having a good time. Sally saw a camera on the ground.

Once upon a time there was a little boy. He was walking through the woods with his mom. All of a sudden they came to a creek and the little boy wanted to play. His mom said it was ok and the boy took off his shoes and socks. He stepped carefully into the water. It was cold and wet, but he liked it!

Once upon a time, there was a planet. On this planet there lived a little girl. Her name was Lucy. One day Lucy saw a curious creature. She was very nervous. She didn't know what to do. Then the creature spoke. "Hello, Lucy," it said. "I come from far away. Can you tell me what planet this is?" Lucy was surprised.

Once there was a little girl called Amy. She was very impatient. One day she saw a ladder near the fence. She wanted to play with it. So she grabbed the ladder and tried to climb it. But she was too small and couldn't reach the top. She was really angry and wanted to get to the top! So she went to get her mum.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with water. One day, she went outside to splash in a big puddle. She jumped and laughed as the water splashed on her legs. It was so much fun! After playing in the puddle, Lily went back inside her house. Her mommy was in the kitchen near the stove.

Lily liked to collect things. She had a big box full of shiny stones, pretty shells, and colorful feathers. She liked to look at them and make patterns with them. Sometimes she shared them with her friends, but only if they were nice to her. One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She saw a furry cat sitting on a bench.

Lily and Ben like to play in the pond. They look for frogs and fish and bugs. They have fun and laugh a lot. One day, they see a big frog on a rock. It is green and brown and has big eyes. Lily wants to catch it and show it to Ben. She is very quiet and moves slowly. She reaches out her hand to grab the frog.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lisa. Lisa loved to play in her garden, especially with her steel buckets. Lisa was so playful that she would often make all the other animals in the garden laugh. One day, Lisa wanted to take her steel buckets for a walk. She skipped down the path, swinging her buckets as she went.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. One day, Timmy and his mommy went on the subway. The subway was a big train that went underground. Timmy noticed that the subway was very crowded. He had to stand up because all the seats were taken. Timmy's mommy gave him a warm hug to make him feel better.

Once there was a cat who loved to swing. He would go out every sunny day to play on the swings. He would go higher and higher, until he was so high that he could barely see the ground anymore. But he always came back down, safe and sound. One day, while the cat was swinging, he heard a tiny voice from near the swings.

John was a little boy. He was three years old. One day, his mommy said they should take a walk. John happily agreed. While walking along, they came across a melon patch. Mommy said it was full of yummy melons. "I want to pick a melon!" said John. But Mommy said no.

Once there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mom took her to the river to go fishing. Mommy: "Let's try and catch a fish, Lily!" Lily was so excited, she grabbed her fishing rod and ran to the river. But when Lily was there, she saw something ugly in the water! It was a big fish! Lily was scared and started to panic.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her dolls and teddy bear. One day, her mommy introduced her to a new vegetable called broccoli. Lily thought it looked dull and didn't want to eat it. Mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. Broccoli is good for you and will make you strong."

Once upon a time there was a leopard. He was very strong and brave. But one day, while walking through the forest, he suddenly saw something very funny! It was a funny little monkey and he was dancing and laughing! The leopard laughed too and he was very happy. Soon, the monkey noticed the leopard and he stopped dancing. Now he was very scared and he felt very helpless.

Once upon a time there was a kind farmer. Everywhere she went, she smiled and felt happy. One day she asked a question. She wondered if there was anything beyond her land. So the kind farmer gathered her things and set off on an adventure. Each day she traveled closer to the horizon. Finally, after many days of traveling, she saw a distant shore.

John was very excited because he was going to the zoo today. He made sure to be extra quiet so he wouldn't wake up his little brother. As he opened the door of his room, he heard a loud noise. He started to panic and said, "Mommy, there's a noise!" Mommy came to the door and said, "It's okay, honey.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Mike and Tom. Tom wanted to go on an adventure, so they decided to get a boat. The two friends looked around to find the best boat. They found a row boat that was very cheap. The boat looked small but Mike said it would be big enough for their adventure. The boys jumped in their boat and Tom grabbed the oars.

Jack and the mineral Jack was a curious three year old, always looking to explore. One day, while Jack was playing in his back garden, he noticed a strange shimmering rock on the ground. Once upon a time, there was a big, green field. On this field, there was a soft, yellow playground. Every day, many happy players would come to play. They would run, jump and act! One day, a new player came to the playground. His name was Peter. Peter was a bit shy, so he watched all the other kids for a while.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to watch the sunset every day. He would sit on the grass and watch the big orange ball go down behind the trees. John was feeling cheerful one day. He was excited to go to his friend's pumpkin patch. When he arrived, he saw many of his friends already at the patch. Once upon a time there was a girl. She had a big, round face and her eyes were fine. She was always happy and her mommy and daddy allowed her to play outside. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she found a bean in her garden. It was a big, round bean. She picked it up and looked at it. The bean was dry and hard. Lily wanted to see if she could make it grow.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, her mommy told her that they were going to visit her grandma's house. Lily was very excited to see her grandma. When they arrived at her grandma's house, Lily saw a big and shiny piano.

Anna and Ben are playing in the park. They have a bottle of bubble soap and a wand. They want to make big bubbles that fly in the air. Anna goes first. She dips the wand in the soap and blows. Once upon a time there was a boy. His name was Max. Max was three years old and he was very curious. He was always looking around and asking questions. One day, he asked his dad, "What is that on top of our house?" His dad explained, "That is the roof."

Tom is a fireman. He wears a red uniform and a big hat. He drives a powerful truck with a loud siren. He helps people when there is a fire. One day, Tom gets a call. There is a fire at a school. He and his friends rush to the scene. They see smoke and flames. They hear children crying. Tom is brave.

Once upon a time, there was a fat gray rabbit. He was very messy. Every day, the rabbit would hop around and leave bits of rubbish behind him. One day, he decided to try something new. He wanted to be clean. So the rabbit got to work. He started picking up the bits of rubbish and tidying them away.

Once upon a time, there was a big castle with a king and a queen. They had a guard who watched the castle to keep it safe. The guard was very strong and brave. He protected the castle from bad guys who wanted to take the treasure. One day, the king and queen wanted to have a party. They invited all their friends from far away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play the piano, and she practiced every day. One day, Lily's friend Emma came over to play. Emma said, "Can I play the piano too?" Lily said, "Sure, but be careful." Emma started to play, but she was not careful.

Once upon a time, there were two friends who went for a walk in the park. It was a nice, sunny day and their eyes sparkled as they took in all the colors around them. Suddenly, one of them stopped walking and looked sad. He began to complain, "This day is so boring! Everything is just gray. I don't like it here."

Sam and Mia were playing with their toys in the living room. Sam had a laser that made bright lights and sounds. Mia had a doll that she liked to dress up and hug. Sam wanted to play with Mia's doll, but Mia said no. "Please, can I have your doll?" Sam asked. "No, it is mine. You have your laser," Mia said.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who lived near a stream. The bird loved to play and sing by the water, but one day, a big storm came and the stream started to rise. The little bird was scared and didn't know what to do. As the water got higher and higher, the little bird saw a big rock nearby.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sydney. She was 3 years old and she loved to play. One day she was playing with her favourite toy - a glove. She loved to pretend it was an airplane and race around the room. Suddenly, Sydney heard a loud noise. She looked up and saw that the glove had broken.

Once upon a time there was a baby goat who was very curious about the world around him. One day he spotted a deep, dark cave and decided to explore it. He walked inside and saw how big and dangerous it was. He was worried but at the same time he was excited to discover what was hidden inside. He decided to keep walking.

Lila and Tom are twins. They like to play in their room. They have many toys and books. But they also have a big closet. The closet is dark and scary. Sometimes they hear noises from the closet. One day, Lila and Tom are bored. They want to have some fun. They decide to play a game. They call it "who is brave?".

Lily and Max are twins. They like to play in their room. They have many toys and books. But they do not like to clean up. Their mom always tells them to put their things away. Once upon a time, there was a tall tree. It had big branches and lots of green leaves. A little bird lived in the tree. The little bird liked to fly around and sing. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she found a yellow flower on the ground. She picked it up and held it close to her face. "Look mommy, I found a pretty flower!" she said. Her mommy smiled and said, "That's a lovely flower, Lily.

Once upon a time, there was a horse. He was a very unusual horse because he liked to read. Every day, he would go to the library and read all day long. He read stories and books about horses and all kinds of adventures. One day, the horse decided to take some books home. He went to the library and chose an exciting book.

One day, Polly and her mom were out for a walk. They were walking together and Polly was very happy. They had been walking for a while, when suddenly Polly said, "Mommy, look!" Mommy looked to where Polly was pointing. She was pointing at a bird who was flying in the sky. "That's a bird, Polly," said Mommy.

The sun was out, so it was time for a ride. Little Jack and his toy wagon set out for an adventure. He filled the wagon with his favorite toys and stuffed animals. Once upon a time, there was a big zoo. It had many animals like lions, monkeys, and elephants. One day, a little girl went to the zoo with her family. She loved seeing all the animals and hearing their sounds. As they walked around, they saw a big sign that said "SLOW DOWN".

Once upon a time, there were two friends. They wanted to explore a deep forest. They walked for a long time until they saw a giant tree. It was so tall and strong that it seemed like the sky! One of the friends picked up a big, shiny fork.

Once upon a time, there was a young tree. It was the smallest tree in the forest. Every day, the little tree wanted to grow tall, like the others. One day, the little tree saw a squirrel. The squirrel said, "If you want to get big, you have to yell!" The little tree thought this was a good idea.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweetie. Tweetie loved to sing and would often perch on a tree and sing all day long. One day, as Tweetie was singing, a little girl named Lily walked by and heard her beautiful voice. Lily asked, "What's in your chest, Tweetie? Is that what makes you sing so pretty?"

Once there was a girl who wanted to find something. She looked everywhere to find it but it was not there. She looked in the backyard, under the stairs, behind the couch, and in the closet, but it was not there. The girl began to get frustrated and she started to cry. Then she had an idea. She thought maybe she could try to find a key.

The zero was fat and the little girl was very scared. She felt alone and sad. Suddenly, her mom came in and hugged her tight. She comforted the little girl and made her feel better. The little girl hugged her mom back. It felt like everything was ok now. She could tell her mom understood and it made her happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sarah. One day, Sarah wanted to get some groceries. She put on her coat and asked her mum, "Can I go get some groceries?" Mum replied, "No my love, it's too dark and I don't want you to go alone." Sarah started to cry. She wanted to get the groceries very badly.

Lily and Sam were friends who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a big store with many things inside. They wanted to go in and look, but the store had a sign that said "Closed". "Let's go in anyway," Sam said. "Maybe we can find something fun." "No, Sam, that is bad," Lily said.

Lila and Ben are playing in the park with their dog, Spot. Spot likes to run and jump and chase balls. He also likes to dig holes and find bones. Sometimes he finds big bones, sometimes he finds small bones, sometimes he finds unusual bones. "Look, Spot found a bone!" Lila says, pointing to a hole.

Charlie was a little boy. He was three years old and he was fit. He was so fit that he could do lots of things. One day, he wanted to play hockey. His mum said to him, "Do you want to play hockey?". Charlie said, "Yes!" His mum gave him a hockey stick.

Once upon a time there was a sad little girl. She had a mark on her arm and it made her feel gloomy. Every day she would look at the mark, but it never seemed to get smaller. One day she decided to try something. She closed her eyes, made a wish and slowly started to shrink. Her feet kept getting smaller and smaller until she fit into a tiny jar!

Katie was 3 years old and she loved going for walks with her mom. On this day, her mom had bought her a new bright pink leash. The leash made her feel very comfortable and she was very excited to use it. She and her mom walked down the street and Katie's feet quickly went faster and faster.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved Halloween and he wanted to make a pumpkin lantern. So, he went to the pumpkin patch and picked a big, orange pumpkin. As he was walking home, he saw a group of ants marching towards a dead leaf. Timmy asked the ants, "Why are you marching?"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who found a stick in the woods one day. She thought it was the most unusual stick she had ever seen! She tried to stand it up on the ground, but it would not stay. Then she heard a voice from behind her. "That's my stick!" said the old man with a scowl.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play with their toys. One day, they found a big envelope on the table. It had a stamp and a sticker that said "Do not open". Tom was curious and wanted to see what was inside. Lily was scared and said "No, Tom, we should not open it. It is not ours.

Once upon a time there was a selfish spoon. The spoon always wanted to be better than everyone else and do things first. One day, the spoon decided to compete in a race and wanted to win! The spoon got ready, standing at the start line with all the other spoons. The race began and the spoon ran as fast as it could, using all its strength.

One day Sam was playing with his toys. He saw his dad and said, "Hi, Dad!" His dad said, "Hi, Sam! Would you like to ride on the zoom?" Sam was excited and said yes. Before they could get in the car, Sam saw his neighbor, Jane also getting in a zoom.

Ben and Mia love to travel with their mom and dad. They go to many places and see many things. Sometimes they go by car, sometimes by train, sometimes by plane. They always have fun and learn new stuff. One day, they travel to a big city. Mom and dad say they will see a show with jazz.

Once there was a little girl called Jane. She was three years old and she really loved to swing on the swing in the park. One day, Jane's dad took her to the park so she could swing. Jane found her favourite seat on the swing and she started to swing joyfully. But then, a big boy rushed over and tried to sit in the same seat.

Once there was a little boy. He was three years old, and he was a bit scared. Every night he would wake up because he heard a strange pattern. He couldn't tell where the pattern was coming from. It was just there, but it wasn't something he heard very often. The little boy was very fearful. He wished he knew where the pattern was coming from.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One night, she had a dream that she was flying high in the sky like a bird. She could see everything from up there! She saw trees, houses, and even some birds flying with her. When she woke up, Lily was sad that her dream was over.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and run around outside. One day, Timmy's mom brought home a beautiful vase from the store. Timmy had never seen a vase like this before. It was big and shiny, but also unknown to him. Timmy's mom put the vase on a table in the living room.

Once there was a little girl who wanted to gain a new scarf. She asked her mommy for a funny scarf. But, mommy was too busy. So the girl decided to go on an adventure to get one. She went looking everywhere in the neighborhood, but no luck. Suddenly, she heard her mommy calling. She had come home from work with a special scarf for her!

Once upon a time, there was a small boat. It was a happy boat, but one day it got lost in the big ocean. The boat felt scared and alone. It cried for help, but no one came. Suddenly, a big wave came and hit the boat. The boat felt even more scared. But then, a friendly dolphin appeared.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a soft and fluffy carpet in her room, which she loved to play on. One day, Lily's mom came into her room and whispered something serious to her. Lily didn't understand what her mom was saying, but she knew it was important.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Jill. Jack wanted to take Jill for lunch, so he took her to a cafe. When they got there, Jack showed Jill the menu. It included lots of different food like burgers, sandwiches and chips. Jill was so excited - it was hard to choose! Jack asked Jill what she wanted and she said she wanted a sandwich.

Once upon a time, there was a boy. His name was Frank. Every day, Frank liked to go to the same special place. The place was dry and bright. Frank always had fun there. He liked to bring little toys that he could keep in his pocket. One day, as he was walking to his special place, he heard a voice calling his name. It was his mom!

Lily liked to go to the park with her mom. She liked to see the flowers, the swings, and the pigeons. She wanted to talk to the pigeons, but they always flew away when she came near. One day, she saw a pigeon that was different. It had a red band on its leg and a shiny ring on its neck. It looked very cheerful and friendly.

Sara liked to dance. She danced in her room, in the garden, and in the park. She danced with her dolls, her dog, and her friends. She danced when she was happy, when she was sad, and when she was bored. One day, Sara's mom took her to a big building. She said they had to see a lawyer.

Once upon a time there was an ice cube. It lived in a big freezer and everyday it heard the happy sounds of the small freezer people. The ice cube was surrounded by bags and boxes filled with all kinds of yummy things. One day the ice cube was taken out of the freezer and put in a bowl. The warmth from the room made the ice cube start to melt.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to play outside in the sun. One day, Max found a big bowl of jelly. He had never seen jelly before, so he was very curious. Max wanted to eat the jelly, but it was so slippery! He tried to grab the jelly, but it slipped right out of his paws.

Once upon a time there was a man who was feeling very sad. He had a bad problem that he didn't know what to do about. He wanted to talk to someone to help him understand what he should do. So he asked his friend where he could go for help. His friend said the best thing to do was to talk to a lawyer.

Tom and Anna are brother and sister. They like to play together, but sometimes they fight. One day, they fight over a toy car. Tom wants to play with it, but Anna says it is hers. They pull and push the toy car until it breaks. "Look what you did!" Anna cries. "You broke my toy car!" "No, you broke it!" Tom shouts.

Once upon a time, there was an octopus who wanted to play a game. He asked his fish friends, "Who wants to play a game with me?" An eager fish agreed to play, and the octopus said, "Let's play a game of twist!" The octopus and the fish began trying to twist.

Tim likes his brown truck very much. He plays with it every day in the yard. He makes it go fast and slow, and he makes it beep and honk. He likes to pretend he is a truck driver and he goes to many places. But one day, his truck gets very dirty. It has mud and grass and bugs on it. Tim does not like his truck to be dirty.

Once upon a time there was a man and a dog. The man was looking for something very special. One day, he found a rope! It was ordinary, but it was special too. He took it home to show his dog. His dog was excited to see the rope. The man and the dog played together with the rope every day. They held it tight and ran around with it.

Once upon a time, there was a green frog who enjoyed getting massages. Every day, the frog would jump from the pond and find a special spot by a tree. The frog would lay down and wiggle his toes. Then, the frog felt something magical happen. The massage began to increase and the frog started to feel better and better.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Amy. She was only three years old and was so excited to explore the world around her. One day, Amy was walking in the park with her Mom. As she was walking, she spotted a brush lying on the floor. She ran up to it and said excitedly, "Mom, look! What's this?"

Sam and Mia liked to play with their toy animals. They had a lot of animals, but their favorite was a soft goat. The goat was white and brown and had a bell around its neck. They named him Billy. One day, Sam and Mia had a fight. They both wanted to play with Billy, but they did not want to share.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a favorite toy, a teddy bear named Teddy. One day, Lily and Teddy went to the park to play. They had so much fun on the swings and the slide. After playing for a while, Lily's mom called her to go home.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a boy and a girl. They liked to play together in the park. One day, they saw a big tree and decided to climb it. The boy climbed higher and higher, but the girl remained at the bottom because she was scared. The boy shouted, "Come on, don't be stupid! You can stand on the branches like me!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved shoes very much and had many pairs. One day, Lily's mom took her to a shoe store to buy her a new pair of shoes. The store had many shoes, but Lily wanted a pair of popular shoes that she had seen in a magazine.

Once there was a little girl who was very silly. She loved to laugh and always managed to find a giggle in even the most boring of days. One day she wanted to achieve a goal. She had an idea of what she wanted and so she set out to do it. As she worked hard and got closer to achieving her goal, she felt very excited.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They saw a man sitting on a bench. He had a wallet in his pocket. Tom had an idea. He said to Lily, "Let's take his wallet. He will not see us. We can buy candy and toys with his money. We are clever." Lily was scared. She said, "No, Tom. That is bad.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and books. But they do not like to share. One day, they have a big fight over a cute shirt. The shirt has a picture of a cat and a bird on it. Lily says, "This is my shirt. I want to wear it today. It is cute and soft."

Once upon a time, there was an ugly paint box. It was so ugly that no one wanted to go near it. One fine day, the paint box decided to escape from its home. So it hopped away from the shelf and started rolling down the street. Everywhere the paint box went, it left a trail of paint behind it.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends called Tom and Jane. Tom and Jane liked to do everything together. One day, Tom and Jane went to the park and saw a big slide. They were excited. Tom said to Jane, "Let's share the slide. You go first!" Jane said, "Thank you, Tom. This slide looks so much fun!"

Once upon a time there was a beautiful girl who lived in a small house in a valley. Every morning, she would wake up and run outside to play with her friends. One day, the girl woke up and there was a magical fairy waiting outside her window. The fairy said, "Come with me and I will show you something special." The girl followed the fairy deep into the woods.

The store was so tidy. Stacks of groceries lined the walls and the aisles. The man in the store looked around for something to buy but he didn't have enough money. So he decided to steal a grocery. Just as he lifted a grocery to his shoulder, a little girl saw him. She was three years old and she was watching from the corner of the store.

The sun shone brightly in the sky, making the yard peaceful and warm. In the yard, there were two children playing. One of the children, a 3 year old boy, picked up a piece of paper. He asked his friend, "What should I do with it?". His friend replied, "Let's print something on it. What words should we print?"

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play in the kitchen. They found a big jar of honey on the shelf and wanted to taste it. Lily climbed on a chair and reached for the jar, but Ben stopped her. "Wait, Lily, we need a teaspoon. Mommy said honey is sticky and messy. We don't want to get in trouble," Ben said.

Once upon a time there was a bird called Joe. Joe was happy and lively. Every day, he would go outside and sing and dance with other birds. One day Joe met Judge, a big, wise old bird. Judge asked Joe to perform a special dance for him. Joe was a bit scared, but he wanted to show Judge how lively he could be.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going for rides in her car seat. Her mommy always made sure to buckle her in tight so she would be safe. One day, they went on a long drive and Lily got very tired. She asked her mommy if she could take a nap. Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, you can take a nap."

Once there was a duck who could swim really well. He was very proud of his swimming ability and loved to show off. One day, a boy and his fan came to the pond where the duck was swimming. The boy was jealous of the duck because he had not seen anyone swim as fast. The boy said to the duck, "Hey duck! I want to swim like you!"

Bob liked to paint. He had lots of colours and a big, clean brush. Especially he liked painting his gate. One day, Bob's Grandma was visiting. Bob showed her his paintings. Grandma said, "Oh Bob! Your gate is so dirty. You should paint it!" Bob said, "Okay!" So Bob and Grandma went outside. They got brushes and paints.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. She was a very happy girl. She loved to read, and had lots of books. One of the things she liked to do was to read aloud; her voice was so loud and clear. One day, Lucy's Mom and Dad gave her a special gift. It was a beautiful flute!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved listening to the radio. He liked to sit in his room and listen to music. One day, Timmy's mom hid the radio. Timmy looked everywhere but he couldn't find it. Later that day, Timmy's dad came home from work. Timmy asked his dad if he had seen the radio.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Lily and Sammy. Lily was an adventurous girl and always wanted to explore the world. One day, she found a peanut. Lily was so excited and she wanted to show Sammy. Lily: "Look Sammy! I found a peanut!" Sammy: "Let me examine it! You can't eat it before examining it!

Once there was a little girl who was very excited. She was going to stay with her grandmother for the night. When she arrived it was already dark out, but the lights inside the house were bright. Grandma was waiting for her and gave her a big hug. They went outside in the garden and grandmother showed her some stars. The little girl was amazed.

Once upon a time, there was a puppy. He was a small and fluffy pup and everyone who saw him just wanted to give him a hug. He was very playful and adventurous. One day a family took the puppy home. They played and laughed together, and the puppy grew up in a loving home.

Once there was a player. He was very ignorant. He thought he was too good to stay in one spot. Everyday he would go to different places and do different things. One night, the player decided to stay in his house. He was curious to see what would happen. As he stayed, magical things started to happen! He found himself in a new world. The player was amazed.

Once upon a time, there was a tall giraffe named Jerry. He loved to listen to the radio while eating leaves from the trees. One day, Jerry's radio stopped working and he was sad. He asked his animal friends if they had a radio he could borrow, but no one did.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable copper fish. He lived in a river. Every day he would swim around, poking his nose into all sorts of things. He would poke at rocks and leaves. He even poked a big log. One day, he decided to poke his nose outside the river. Suddenly, he saw something amazing. It was an even bigger fish.

Once upon a time, there was a big jungle with lots of animals living in it. One day, a lion was walking around, looking for something to eat. The other animals were scared of the lion because it was very strong and could hurt them. One day, a little rabbit was playing in the jungle when it saw the lion coming.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and always took good care of them. One day, Timmy's little sister came into his room and tried to take his favorite toy car. Timmy didn't want his sister to take his toy car, so he covered it with a blanket to hide it from her.

Anna liked to read books at night. She had a lamp that could glow in the dark. She would turn it on and look at the pictures and words in her books. She had many books, but her favorite was about a princess and a dragon. One night, her brother Tom came into her room. He was older and bigger than Anna.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily and her mommy went to the park. Lily wanted to play on the swings, but there was a big line. She started to complain to her mommy, saying "I want to swing now!" While they waited, Lily noticed a mystery. She saw a squirrel hiding nuts in the ground.

Once upon a time there was a very enthusiastic bunny. She wanted to explore the world and so she hopped until she came to a field of grass. She saw a big umbrella in the middle of the field. She hopped over to it and when she got there she discovered that it was a special magical umbrella. With a wave of her paw the umbrella suddenly started to rock back and forth.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a notebook that she loved to draw in. One day, she went to the park with her mommy and daddy. They walked slow so Lily could look at all the pretty flowers. Suddenly, Lily dropped her notebook and it fell on the ground. She was very sad because she thought her drawings were ruined.

Once there was a mommy and a baby. The mommy was very smart. One day, she said, "Let's go to the store and buy some tuna!" The baby was so excited. He shouted, "Tuna!" At the store, the mommy picked up a can of tuna and put it in the cart. The baby said, "Mommy, what is that?"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He was 3 years old and he loved to play in the mud. He would fold his hands and then jump in, laughing! One day, he wanted to play in the mud again. But when he went outside, it had started to rain. "Terrible!", he said loudly.

Anna loves animals. She likes to play with her dog, Max, and her hamster, Pip. One day, she sees a new animal in her garden. It is small and furry, with big eyes and a long tail. It is a kitten! Anna runs to the kitten and says hello. The kitten is scared at first, but Anna is gentle and friendly.

Sara and Tom are playing hide and seek in the park. Sara is the seeker and Tom is the hider. Tom runs behind a big tree and waits for Sara to find him. He thinks he is very hidden and Sara will not see him. Sara looks around the park and tries to find Tom. She sees a swing, a slide, a bench, and a flower.

Sara and Ben were playing hide and seek in the park. Sara was the seeker and Ben was the hider. Ben ran to a big tree and hid behind it. He was very quiet and hoped Sara would not find him. Sara looked around and saw many places where Ben could be. She saw a slide, a swing, a bench, and a fountain.

Once there was a boy. His name was Toby. He was three years old. One day his mom said, "Let's make some cookies!" Toby was so excited. He clapped his hands. His mom gave him a job to do. His job was to stir the cookie dough. He started stirring. It felt so nice. His mom mixed in some tasty chocolate chips.

Once upon a time, there lived a bald man. He lived in a small town and spent his days working at the local store. Every day, he worked hard and never complained. One day, on his way home, he saw a little girl in tears. He asked her what was wrong. She said that she had lost her toy and she wanted it back.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a loyal dog named Max. Max loved to play and run with Timmy. One day, Timmy and Max went for a walk. Timmy brought his pencil with him to draw pictures. As they walked, Timmy saw a big rock. He wanted to climb it, but it was too high.

Tim and Sam were playing in the park. They liked to swing and slide and run. They saw a big tree with many leaves. They wanted to climb the tree and see the birds. They ran to the tree and found a saw on the ground. It was shiny and sharp. Tim picked up the saw and said, "Look, Sam, I have a saw.

Once upon a time there was a dad who wanted to build something special. It was for his little girl and it was going to be a porch. The dad wanted the porch to be very tight and safe so the little girl could play on it. So he got out the tools and started to build. He hammered, sawed, and drilled until the porch was just right.

Anna and Ben were playing with their toys in the garden. They had a lot of toys, but they liked to share them with each other. They had a ball, a doll, a car, a book, and a teddy bear. But then, a thief came. He was a big boy, and he was mean. He saw the toys and he wanted them.

Once upon a time, there was a nice penguin who lived in the snow. The penguin liked to play with its friends, but it did not have any toys. So, the penguin decided to throw some snowballs at its friends. They had so much fun! One day, the penguin saw a big snowball and thought it would be fun to throw it.

The little boy was excited. His father had a new fast motorcycle. It had big wheels and a big engine. The little boy wanted to try out the motorcycle. He begged his father to let him ride it. After a long time, his father finally agreed. The father took the little boy outside and sat him on the seat of the motorcycle.

Once upon a time there was a bald man called Tom. Tom was walking in the woods one day, when he heard something. It sounded like a loud pitch. He started to move closer to find out what the sound was. As he moved closer to the sound, he saw a big green frog. The frog was making the loud pitch.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world around her. One day, she was walking in the park when she saw a butterfly flying around. "Look, Mommy!" she said excitedly, "A pretty butterfly!" Her mom smiled and asked, "Do you want to try and catch it?"

Lily was playing with her dolls in her room. She liked to comb their hair and make them look pretty. She had a pink comb, a blue comb and a yellow comb. She gave each doll a different comb. "Hello, Daisy," she said to her pink doll. "You have long hair. I will comb it with the pink comb. It is your favorite color."

Sara and Ben are in the kitchen with Mom. Mom is making dinner. She has a big knife and a white thing. Sara asks, "What is that, Mom?" Mom says, "This is a cauliflower. It is a vegetable. We can eat it." Ben says, "I don't like vegetables. They are yucky." Mom says, "No, they are not.

Tim and Lily were having lunch with their mom. They had pasta with sauce and cheese. Tim liked sauce a lot. He put a lot of sauce on his pasta. Lily did not like sauce. She only ate cheese. "Yum, yum, sauce is good," Tim said. He smiled and licked his lips. "Yuck, yuck, sauce is bad," Lily said.

Once upon a time, there was an old tree. It was an apple tree, and it was very special because it had been in the same spot for many years. One day, a funny-looking black bird flew down to the tree. The bird was very small, but it was also very determined. You see, it wanted to help restore the old tree!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who liked to explore the world. He liked to walk around his garden and jump in the puddles. One day, he saw something really special, there was a beautiful fence painted pink. He thought it was really charming. The little boy wanted to pass the fence and explore what was beyond it. He asked his mom for permission.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a small pony named Pip. Mia and Pip liked to play in the mild sun. They were very happy. One day, Mia and Pip were playing near the big tree. A little boy named Tim came by. Tim saw Pip and said, "Wow, I like your pony! Can I pet him?"

Mommy and Johnny were packing to go on an adventure. "We're going to the icy caves!" said Mommy. Johnny was excited, but also a little scared. "Will we see any ghosts?" he asked. "No, no ghosts!" said Mommy. When they arrived at the icy caves, Johnny's eyes were wide. The caves were so cold and dark!

Once upon a time, there was a little house in the woods. In the house, there were two best friends- Eddie and Mandy. Every day, Mandy would take out the little ashtray and sit on the floor. She would take out a pencil and paper, and record all of the things they would do together.

Once upon a time there was a wee boy. He was playing in the park one day. Suddenly, he saw a big hairy bug. He was so scared! But he pressed on his brave knee and tried to resist it. But the hairy bug was too big. It kept coming closer and closer. The boy tried to run away, but the bug followed him!

Once upon a time there was an old man. He loved to march and soon he was marching everywhere. One day the old man looked at his shoes. They were all worn out and he needed new ones. So the old man went to the shop to buy a new pair, but all he could find were old shoes.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who didn't want to mind. He was tired of being told what to do. One day, the little boy saw a paint set and he suddenly knew what to do. He wanted to paint a picture but his mom said no. The little boy was feeling helpless. The next day, the mom said the little boy could have some paint.

Once upon a time there lived a fish. The fish wanted a seat all to itself, so it swam around until it found one. It was very happy when it found the seat and settled down. But it was soon in for a surprise - another fish had found the seat, too!

One day, Peter was walking in the woods. As he strolled, he heard the sound of a mill. He looked up and saw a big, round building. He walked inside and saw many people working hard. They all turned to look at him. One of the workers asked, "What are you doing here, little one?" Peter didn't know what to say.

Alex had a cool pastel shirt. He was so proud of it because it was the first shirt he ever picked out himself. Even though it was pastel and cool, it made Alex just a bit embarrassed. He loved the shirt; the pastel colors of pink and blue looked perfect together. His friends thought it was cool too. But when it was time for school, Alex got a bit scared.

Once upon a time, there was a big park with a wide river. In the park, there was a statue of a happy dog. The dog was very pretty and lots of children liked to play around it. One day, a man came to the park and he wanted to lock the gate. The gate was the only way to get in and out of the park.

John was very hungry. He needed a piece of food, but he didn't have any. He looked around and saw a piece of cake on the kitchen counter. He thought he needed it, so he took it. John felt guilty, but he ate it anyway. He knew he shouldn't have taken it, but he was so hungry.

Once upon a time, there was a small deer. He was so tiny and so soft! With big brown eyes, he was yummy and special. He loved to explore the world; hopping and playing all day long. One day he was out hopping, when he saw the big, cold freezer. He was curious and wanted to know what was inside.

Lily was 3 years old and loved waffles. She always laughed when the light was bright and she could see the yellow waffle in front of her. Today was a special day, her parents promised her a big surprise when the sun was in the sky. That morning was very bright and sunny. Lily opened her bedroom door and asked with a smile, "Where is my surprise?".

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a rare toy telephone. It was red and blue, and he loved it very much. He played with it every day and took it everywhere he went. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He played with his telephone while his mom sat on a bench.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very brave and liked to try new things. One day she saw a swing in the park. She had never seen anything more magical and wanted to try it. She sat down, grabbed the ropes, and pushed off. The girl loved swinging higher and higher. It felt like she was flying! Then suddenly she felt embarrassed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She wanted to dance, so she ran to the forest. The forest was very soft and the sun was shining bright. The girl started to twirl and jump in the forest. She was so happy because she felt the warmth of the sun on her face and the grass tickling her toes. She felt so free!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a big sister named Sally who liked to tease him. One day, Timmy got very mad at Sally and decided to hide in a dark closet. While he was in the closet, he found an incredible toy that he had never seen before. He played with the toy for a long time until he fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, they decided to see who could balance on one foot the longest. Timmy tried his best, but he fell down after only a few seconds. He felt embarrassed in front of his friends. But Timmy didn't give up.

Johnny was a curious three-year-old. On the way to school, he started to discover that something was strange. He saw some smelly garbage on the left side of the street. Johnny didn't know then, but he was about to discover something very special. As Johnny walked down the street, he saw more and more smelly garbage. He started to feel a little confused.

Once upon a time there was a boy with a shoe. It was a special shoe because it could spring. So one day the little boy decided he wanted to go on an adventure with his shoe! He put it on and jumped. The shoe went really high! The boy laughed and was so excited. He loved his special shoe. Then one day the boy was bad.

Lily and Sam are twins. They like to play with their toys. They have many toys, but they want more. One day, they see a big blue car in the shop. They ask their mom to buy it for them. Mom says no. She says the car is too expensive. She says they have enough toys. She says they should be happy with what they have.

One day, a poor bird was sad because he could not fly. His wing was hurt. He sat on the ground and looked up at the sky. He saw a big, pretty rainbow. A nice cat saw the bird and said, "Why are you sad, bird?" The bird said, "I cannot fly and I want to see the rainbow up close."

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Jane. She was very happy, because she had a special diary that she liked to write in every day. One day, while playing outside with her best friend, Jane noticed that her diary was missing! She was very upset, and she asked her friend, "Where is my diary?" Her friend said, "I don't know.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mom asked her to come to the grocery store with her. Lily was very excited because she loved going to the grocery store. She liked to see all the different fruits and vegetables and pick out her favorite ones. When they got to the store, Lily saw a boy who was crying.

Once upon a time there was an ornament. It was black and sparkly. Everyday a little girl would come and look at the ornament. She loved the shiny, black ornament very much. One day, the girl decided to take the ornament home with her. She put it in her pocket and started running away.

Once upon a time, there was a blue puzzle. It had many pieces, and it was very hard to put them all together. A little girl named Lily wanted to play with the puzzle, but she didn't know how to do it. She tried and tried, but she couldn't figure it out. One day, Lily left the puzzle outside in the sun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big yellow balloon that she loved very much. One day, she accidentally let go of the string and the balloon flew away. She was very sad and started to cry. Her mom saw her crying and asked, "What's wrong, Lily?" "My balloon flew away," Lily said.

Once upon a time there was a loyal dog. His name was Tim. He liked to spread joy among his friends. He used to do something special every day. One day, Timâ€™s owner took him to the vet for an exam. The vet said that Tim had to stay overnight. Tim was sad but he stayed loyal.

Tim and Sam are brothers. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big red slide. Tim wants to go on the slide, but Sam is scared. "Come on, Sam, it is fun!" Tim says. He runs to the slide and climbs up the ladder. He sits on the top and smiles. "No, Tim, it is too high!"

Once there was a tiger walking in a forest. Suddenly, he stopped in one spot. He saw something that made him very happy. There was a brilliant glow coming from a nearby tree. The tiger asked the tree, "What is glowing there?" The tree answered, "It is a special light. It comes from my roots. This light will help all the animals of the forest."

Once upon a time there was a very delicate nature in a small village. It was a beautiful place; with its majestic trees and playful critters. One day, a little boy and his father went to mail some letters.

Ginger was a very curious little girl. She was always changing her outfits. Today she wanted to look extra fancy. Her mom helped her pick out a pink dress and a pair of shiny shoes. Ginger was so excited that she twirled around in a circle. Mom asked her, "Do you want to brush your hair?" Ginger nodded and grabbed her brush.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play on the beach and look at the sea. One day, she found a shiny shell and showed it to her mom. "Mommy, can I keep this shell? It's important to me," she requested. Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Lily. That shell is very pretty.

Tom and Mia like to play in the garden. They see many bugs there. Some are big and some are little. Tom likes to catch the bugs in a jar. Mia likes to look at them and let them go. One day, Tom finds a little bug with many colors. He thinks it is pretty. He puts it in his jar and shows it to Mia.

Once upon a time, there was a hungry frog. He was so hungry that he decided to go into the forest. When he arrived, he saw a grasshopper sitting on a rock. The frog said, "Hi, grasshopper. Can I have some food please?" The grasshopper replied, "No, I don't have any food for you."

Anna likes to comb her hair every morning. She has a pink comb that her mom gave her. She thinks it makes her hair shiny and pretty. She keeps her comb in her drawer next to her bed. One day, Anna wakes up and looks for her comb. But she cannot find it. She looks in her drawer, under her bed, in her closet, but it is not there.

Once there was a girl called Amie. Amie loved to chew gum. She would eat it every day. One day she went to the store to buy some gum. There, she saw a friendly man. She went up to him and said: "Hello! What is your name?". The man replied: "My name is Nick". Amie said: "That's a nice name!

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Benny. Benny loved to hop and play in the grass, but one day he saw a big, scary fox. The fox wanted to eat Benny! Benny was so scared that he ran and ran until he found a hole in the ground. He went underground to hide. But then Benny realized he was lost.
